#en: The stolen routing file redraws Neon's maintenance arteries, threading hidden service tunnels into the same shadow lanes your earlier freight yard logs marked as "accidental" failure zones.  \nTogether, they trace Vector's preferred approach vector toward her next grav-sensitive hunting ground.
zh: 失窃的航路文件重绘了霓虹城的维护动脉，把隐秘的检修隧道接入你早先货运场日志标为"意外"故障区的同一条暗影航线。\n二者合力，勾出"向量"偏好的接近矢量，指向她下一个对重力敏感的猎场。

#en: Decoded from the vault-ship's cold archives, the pattern of altered jumps and silenced warnings forms a single, elegant trajectory.  \nFollowed backwards, every storm, every denial, every dead relay resolves into one converging line, pointing toward where Vector has been guiding the sky itself.
zh: 从金库飞船冰冷的档案中解码后，被篡改的跃迁与被消音警告所构成的图案，汇成一条优雅的单一轨迹。\n逆向追溯，每一场风暴、每一次否认、每一座死中继，都归入一条汇聚的直线，指向"向量"一直在引导天空本身的地方。

#en: Dockside gossip knots around a single soft-spoken courier, the same accent and half-glimpsed sigil surfacing in stories from loaders, med techs, and smugglers alike.  \nPulled together, those whispers nudge the hunt toward Neon's shadows and the forgotten routes only old hands still dare to name.
zh: 码头边的闲言碎语都缠在一个说话轻声细语的信使身上，同样的口音与惊鸿一瞥的徽记，在装卸工、医疗技师和走私犯的故事里反复浮现。\n把这些低语拼到一起，追查便被推向霓虹城的阴影，以及只有老手仍敢点名的那些被遗忘的航线。

#en: Miners once joked the soil there pulled a little harder, that dropped tools fell at a "crooked angle."  \nLab scans of the residue prove it: the same subtle distortion seen in misaligned beacons and dead relays, pointing toward a region of space where gravity itself seems to be learning new tricks.
zh: 矿工们曾开玩笑说那里的土壤拉扯得更用力些，掉落的工具会以"歪斜的角度"坠落。\n残留物的实验室扫描证实了这一点：与错位信标、死中继上见过的一模一样的细微畸变，指向一片连重力本身似乎都在学习新把戏的空域。

#en: Lines on the map arc out from Neon's underbelly and the pirates' rusted bunker, converging on a single forgotten patch of soil where no patrol ever lingers.  \nThe pattern is too deliberate to ignore, a curve drawn in stolen telemetry and dead men's routes, all pointing toward the same abandoned farm.
zh: 地图上的线条从霓虹城的腹地与海盗生锈的地堡向外拱起，汇聚到一小片被遗忘的土地，那里从无巡逻停留。\n这图案刻意得无法忽视——一条以失窃遥测和死者航线画出的曲线，全都指向同一座废弃农场。

#en: The coordinates hidden in the drift data trace every recent convoy loss back to a single, faint bend in local space, like a thumb pressed into the dust of the lane.  \nWhatever is reshaping courses out here, it is not random miscalculation or bad luck anymore; someone has been quietly editing the map.
zh: 藏在漂移数据里的坐标，把近来每一次运输队损失都追溯回本地空间一处微弱的弯折，像是有人用拇指按进航道的尘土里。\n不管是什么在重塑此处的航向，它都不再是随机的计算失误或坏运气；有人一直在悄悄编辑这张地图。

#en: Each mismatched entry on the manifests traces a ship that never flew the route it paid for, all diverted through the same quiet relay in the dark.  \nFollow that relay, and you follow the hand that has been quietly redrawing every lane since the first dataslate you pulled out of that forgotten dead drop.
zh: 舱单上每一条对不上的记录，都追出一艘从未飞过它所付航线费用的飞船，它们全都改道穿过黑暗中同一座安静的中继站。\n顺着那座中继站追，你追的就是那只从你最早在那处被遗忘死信箱里取出数据板起、就一直在悄悄重绘每条航线的手。

#en: The equations curl back on themselves, echoing the corrections you saw whispered through freighter logs and homesteader beacons.  \nPlotted in three dimensions, the draft links the dusty outpost, the skewed orbital relay, and Gagarin's barroom stories into a single converging route toward his hiding place.
zh: 这些方程自我缠绕，回响着你在货船日志与农场信标间低语见到的那些修正。\n用三维方式标绘出来，这份草图把尘土飞扬的哨站、歪斜的轨道中继站和加加林星酒吧里的传闻串成一条通往他藏身处的汇聚路线。

#en: Dock codes and timestamps line up like teeth in a gear, all pointing to one outbound route Neon customs never quite remembers stamping.  \nIn a few scratched entries, the same freighter that haunted the mining hub and that forgotten rock reappears, always taking on sealed tanks under watchful, nameless handlers.
zh: 船坞代码与时间戳像齿轮上的齿一样排列整齐，全都指向霓虹城海关怎么也记不起盖过章的某条出港航线。\n在几条被划花的记录里，那艘困扰过采矿中枢与那块被遗忘岩石的货船再度现身，总是在警惕的无名经手人眼皮底下装载密封储罐。

#en: The ship's corrupted logs finally align: a buried access route, rerouted through corporate channels, pointing down toward Neon's glow.  \nWhat began as a stray dataslate and a flickering orbital beacon now forms a pattern of rewritten debts, vanished warrants, and one name quietly threaded through every correction.
zh: 飞船损坏的日志终于对齐：一条被掩埋的访问路线，经企业渠道改道，指向下方的霓虹城灯火。\n始于一块散落数据板与一座闪烁轨道信标的东西，如今构成一幅由改写的债务、消失的逮捕令，以及一个被悄然贯穿每处修正的名字组成的图案。

#en: When the shard burns out, its fragmented routes try to re-sync one last time, bleeding ghost coordinates into the depot's dead consoles.  \nIn the static, a pattern clarifies: the same tug vectors, the same erased claims, all converging on a stretch of space where containers go dark long before any insurer files the loss.
zh: 碎片烧毁时，它破碎的航线最后一次尝试重新同步，把幽灵坐标渗进仓库死去的控制台。\n在静电噪声中，一个图案渐渐清晰：同样的拖船向量、同样被抹除的索赔，全都汇聚到一片空域——那里的货柜早在任何保险公司登记损失之前就已失联。

#en: Traced through half-erased comm logs and hushed corridor gossip, the route shows a subtle bend in traffic patterns no dispatcher will admit seeing.  \nFollowed outward, those diverted jumps and missing storm reports all arc toward the same thin corridor of space, the first solid line through Vector's carefully blurred map.
zh: 透过半被抹除的通讯日志与走廊里压低嗓音的闲话一路追溯，这条路线显示出交通模式中一处没有调度员肯承认见过的细微弯折。\n向外延伸，那些改道的跃迁与缺失的风暴报告都弯向同一片狭长空域——这是穿过"向量"精心模糊的地图的第一条实线。

#en: Lines in the module's stolen records split like a forked jump: one branch buried in corporate experiments, the other bending back toward dead relays and lost ships.  \nCross-checking those fragments with the first ghost traces from that forgotten station, the hunter sees the same signature nudging every route just off safe.
zh: 模块失窃记录中的线条像一次分叉跃迁般裂开：一支埋在企业实验里，另一支弯回死中继与失踪船只。\n把这些碎片与那座被遗忘空间站最早的幽灵痕迹交叉比对，猎人便看到同样的特征把每条航线都轻推离安全线。

#en: On a forgotten Trade Authority support ship, wedged between stale manifests and scrubbed route logs, the key is not what it unlocks but what it still points toward.  \nIts encoded vectors mirror the half-whispered jumps you heard planetside, hinting that someone meant to erase this trail and never came back to finish the job.
zh: 在一艘被遗忘的贸易管理局支援船上，夹在过期的舱单与被擦净的航路日志之间，这把钥匙重要的不是能打开什么，而是它仍指向何处。\n它编码的向量映照出你在地表听来的半带低语的跃迁，暗示有人本想抹除这条线索，却再没回来收尾。

#en: Lines of stolen telemetry, storm signatures, and falsified transponders align across the cracked display, all pulsing toward the same narrow band of sky and rock.  \nWhoever mapped this expected to spring a trap; instead, their calculations expose the path she favors, where reactors, thin air, and unstable weather always meet.
zh: 失窃遥测、风暴特征与伪造应答器的线条在龟裂的显示屏上对齐，全都脉动着指向同一片狭窄的天空与岩石带。\n绘制这一切的人本想设下陷阱；结果他们的计算反倒暴露出她偏爱的路径——那里反应堆、稀薄大气与不稳定天气永远交汇。

#en: From the wreckage of the shattered array, the last telemetry fans outward, collapsing into a single trajectory that ignores every sanctioned lane and patrol grid.  \nThe pattern threads through the noise of trade and war and settles, inevitably, on a cold, decommissioned complex where the power draw is wrong for an empty shell.
zh: 从碎裂阵列的残骸中，最后的遥测向外散开，收敛成一条无视所有制式航道与巡逻网格的单一轨迹。\n这图案穿过贸易与战争的噪声，最终必然落在一座冰冷、已退役的设施上——那里的耗电量对一具空壳而言并不正常。

#en: The altered grow patterns mirror his ruined colonies exactly, tracing a chain of starving habitats toward one narrow, untreated band of space he keeps skirting.  \nFrom the dead farmstead to the derelict buoy and the scrubbed cargo records, every fragment now bends toward that same overlooked corridor he has been using all along.
zh: 被篡改的种植模式与那些毁坏的殖民地如出一辙，勾出一条由挨饿居所连成的链，通向他一再绕行的那条狭窄、未经处理的空域。\n从死去的农场到废弃浮标再到被擦净的货运记录，每一块碎片如今都弯向他一直使用的那条被忽视的走廊。

#en: Two overlapping shipment trails emerge from the records, both wearing the same medical codes, both ending where official charts run out.  \nOne path feeds polished labs and corporate armories, the other bleeds quietly toward forgotten veterans and dead frontlines, forcing the hunt to choose which shadow of Catalyst to follow first.
zh: 记录中浮现出两条重叠的货运轨迹，都带着相同的医疗编码，都终止于官方星图终止之处。\n一条路径养活光鲜的实验室与企业军械库，另一条则悄然流向被遗忘的老兵与死去的战线，迫使追查者选择先追"催化剂"的哪一道影子。

#en: Lines of altered risk scores and redirected supplies map a quiet path from corporate boardrooms back down into these crowded levels, where the first triage queues once overflowed.  \nIn his edits you finally see the pattern, connecting the lost colony's frozen calls, the tampered orbital beacon, and the whispered data sale in Neon.
zh: 被篡改的风险评分与改道的补给，勾出一条从企业董事会悄然向下延伸至这些拥挤层级的路径——最早的伤员分诊队列曾在那里溢出。\n在他的修改里，你终于看清了图案：它把失落殖民地冻结的呼叫、被动手脚的轨道信标，以及霓虹城里低语的数据交易联在一起。

#en: Tucked in a forgotten locker on the courier, the manifests show the same ship sliding off registered lanes, then reappearing beneath Neon's storm-lit decks.  \nEvery altered jump echoes earlier signs: the quiet farm that vanished, the crooked beacon in orbit, the erased logs that always bent back toward her unseen hand on the charts.
zh: 塞在信使飞船上一个被遗忘的储物柜里，舱单显示同一艘船滑离登记航道，随后又出现在霓虹城被风暴照亮的甲板之下。\n每一次被篡改的跃迁都回响着更早的迹象：消失的安静农场、轨道上歪斜的信标、总是弯回她在星图上那只看不见的手的被抹除日志。

#en: Hidden in the ship's overlooked maintenance logs, the cycling patterns match every poisoned settlement's supply window, then taper off toward a single, unmonitored band of space.  \nThe dead rock, the scrubbed cargo approvals, and now this forgotten process all trace the same narrow corridor where his routes vanish from official eyes.
zh: 藏在飞船被忽视的维护日志里，那些循环模式与每一座中毒定居点的补给窗口吻合，随后收窄指向同一片无人监视的空域。\n死去的岩石、被擦净的货物审批，如今再加上这道被遗忘的流程，全都勾出同一条狭窄走廊——他的航线在那里从官方眼中消失。

#en: Buried in the draft's coordinates, past the medical redactions and falsified case notes, lies one repeating lattice of jumps that should not exist.  \n\nFollow that pattern, and every earlier anomaly the lost freighter, the doctored cargo logs, the erased war-time sims bends toward a single, silent corridor at the edge of mapped space.
zh: 埋在草图的坐标里，越过被涂黑的医疗内容与伪造的病例记录，藏着一座本不该存在的、反复出现的跃迁格栅。\n\n顺着这个图案，此前每一处异常——失踪的货船、被动过手脚的货运日志、被抹除的战时模拟——都弯向制图空间边缘一条寂静的走廊。

#en: Ink-stained pages list ports, dates, and payoffs, turning a forgotten farm into the quiet hub of a smuggling spine that never touches official charts.  \nCross-referenced with the earlier stray dataslate and frontier testimonies about armed escorts, the pattern narrows to a single corridor only someone like MacLeod could have designed.
zh: 墨迹斑斑的书页列出港口、日期与贿赂，把一座被遗忘的农场变成一条从不触碰官方星图的走私干线的安静枢纽。\n与早先那块散落数据板以及边境关于武装护航的证词交叉比对，图案收窄到只有像麦克劳德那样的人才设计得出的单条走廊。

#en: When the old telemetry routines finally spit out raw paths instead of sanitized reports, one arc repeats across the data like a heartbeat.  \nThe same curve links the abandoned farm, the worried Ranger files, and this refinery to a quiet orbit far from patrol routes, narrowing the hunt from rumor to a single, deliberate corridor of sky.
zh: 当旧的遥测程序终于吐出原始路径而非经过净化的报告时，一道弧线像心跳般在数据中反复出现。\n同一条曲线把废弃农场、令人担忧的游骑兵档案和这座精炼厂连向远离巡逻路线的寂静轨道，把追查从传言收窄为一条刻意划出的天空走廊。

#en: Lines traced on the weathered map stitch the forgotten farm to hidden outposts and dead drops, turning scattered rumors into a single, deliberate corridor through the frontier.  \nEvery mark matches earlier scraps of route data, eyewitness talk of armed escorts, and those erased station logs, all curving toward the same unseen destination.
zh: 风化地图上描出的线条把被遗忘的农场与隐秘哨站、死信箱缝在一起，把零散的传闻变成一条刻意穿过边境的单一走廊。\n每一处标记都与早先的零碎航路数据、目击者关于武装护航的说法，以及那些被抹除的空间站日志吻合，全都弯向同一个看不见的目的地。

#en: When the core ruptures, its last emission is not light but a whisper through the grid, peeling away layers of spoofed tags and buried corrections.  \nFor a moment every beacon it touched runs clean, and one unmasked coordinate hangs alone in the dark, matching the ghost traces pulled from the derelict war-room and the broken freighter logs.
zh: 核心爆裂时，它最后释放的不是光，而是一道穿过电网的低语，剥去一层层伪造标签与深埋的修正。\n有那么一刻，它触碰过的每座信标都变得干净，一个被揭下面具的坐标孤零零悬在黑暗中，与从废弃作战室和损坏货船日志中提取的幽灵痕迹吻合。

#en: The Cold Yard Index glows amid dead traffic logs, a quiet spine of coordinates threading through erased patrols, missing tugs, and bought-off claims.  \nWhat began as a stray dataslate in the dust, then half-redacted reports in a buried monitoring bunker, now resolves into a single pattern pointing straight toward the hidden scrapyard grave.
zh: 《冷堆场索引》在死寂的交通日志中亮起，一条安静的坐标脊柱贯穿被抹除的巡逻、失踪的拖船和被收买的索赔。\n始于尘土中一块散落数据板、继而是在被掩埋的监测地堡里半被涂黑的报告的东西，如今汇成一个图案，径直指向那座隐秘的废料场坟墓。

#en: Fuel records on the scout ship show quiet overfills and short burns, all timed to match departures from HopeTown that never reached their stated destinations.  \n\nCross-referenced with the old relay's dead logs and that forgotten rock's nav cache, the pattern narrows to one recurring jump angle, always bending toward the same uncharted dark.
zh: 侦察船上的燃料记录显示，多次安静的过量加注与短促燃烧，全都安排得与霍普镇那些从未抵达申报目的地的离港记录对得上。\n\n与旧中继站的死日志和那块被遗忘岩石的导航缓存交叉比对，图案收窄到同一个反复出现的跃迁角度，总是弯向同一片未被测绘的黑暗。

#en: Decoded from the archive's crowded schematics, one set of coordinates repeats, threaded through stress maps and jump logs like a signature hidden in the welds.  \nIt links the Ranger's off record notes to a single, isolated grav shadow far beyond busy lanes, where someone has been quietly building and testing a frame no registry admits exists.
zh: 从档案拥挤的示意图中解码后，同一组坐标反复出现，像藏在焊缝里的签名一样贯穿应力图与跃迁日志。\n它把游骑兵未入档的笔记连向繁忙航线之外一处孤立的重力暗影——有人正在那里悄悄建造并测试一具没有任何登记档案承认存在的框架。

#en: The overlay is a scar carved into Navy nav data, a thin corridor of jumps that skirts patrol routes and populated wells alike, ending in a patch of mapped nothing someone took great care not to name.  \nMatched against the stray logs, the shack's glitching telemetry, and the ghost freighter's drive history, it turns rumor into a repeatable path.
zh: 这层叠加图是刻在海军导航数据上的一道疤，一条贴着巡逻路线与繁华重力井边缘的狭长跃迁走廊，终点落在某片有人小心翼翼不肯命名的、被测绘为"无"的区域。\n拿它与散落日志、小屋里故障的遥测，以及幽灵货船的引擎历史比对，它便把传言变成了一条可复现的路径。

#en: When the core ruptures, its last act is to scream; a dying burst of telemetry knifes through the static and paints a single, off grid military signature on your display before winking out.  \nThe signal path is clear now, stripped of masking echoes from frontier farms and that quiet retreat where the first frightened testimonies began this chase.
zh: 核心爆裂时，它最后的动作是尖啸；一束垂死的遥测穿透静电，在你的显示屏上烙下一个脱离网格的军用信号，随后熄灭。\n信号路径如今清晰了，剥去了来自边境农场与那处安静隐居地的遮蔽回声——最初的惊恐证词正是在那里拉开了这场追查。

#en: The log stitches together evacuation codes from old battlefields, present-day clinic transfers, and a single repeating destination tag scrubbed from most records but left intact here by a tired clerk.  \nFollow that forgotten routing code and every ghost patient she touched ends up funneled toward one last, mothballed barracks waiting in the dark.
zh: 日志把旧战场的撤离编码、当下的诊所转运，以及一个从多数记录中被抹除、却被一名疲惫文书在此留下的反复出现的目的地标签缝合在一起。\n顺着这个被遗忘的航路编码追下去，她触碰过的每一个幽灵病患最终都被导入一座在黑暗中等待的、最后封存的营房。

#en: In the quiet vault ship, the stolen routes line up like confession lines, and the Vector Echo Stack stitches them together into a single, deliberate pattern of detours.  \nFrom the backwater outpost to the glitched beacon in orbit, every wrong turn now points toward the same unseen hand, drawing you closer along corridors no one officially charts.
zh: 在安静的金库飞船里，失窃的航线像忏悔者排成的队列一样整齐，而向量回响堆把它们缝成一幅刻意设计的绕行图案。\n从穷乡哨站到轨道上故障的信标，每一次错弯如今都指向同一只看不见的手，沿着无人正式制图的走廊把你越拉越近。

#en: Lines of corrupted telemetry realign as the log plays, tracing the same anomaly you saw buried in old UC archives, now extended far past official traffic lanes.  \nEach repeated spike marks a relay Vector has already touched, the final burst pointing toward one last silent station sitting just off the charts, where the pattern surely ends or breaks.
zh: 随着日志播放，损坏的遥测线条重新对齐，勾勒出你曾见埋在旧联殖档案里的同一处异常，如今延伸得远超官方交通航道。\n每一个重复的尖峰都标记着一座"向量"已经触碰过的中继站，最后的爆发指向制图边缘外最后一座寂静空间站——图案必然在那里终结或断裂。

#en: The manifests show the same freighter slipping off registered lanes, hugging weather-heavy worlds and forgotten co-ops before vanishing from official sight.  \nCross-referenced with the dead archive and the first cache, those drift entries finally sketch a route, not random jumps, pointing toward wherever Dustback thinks the soil is worth defending.
zh: 舱单显示同一艘货船滑离登记航道，贴着天气恶劣的世界与被遗忘的合作社航行，随后从官方视野中消失。\n与死档案和第一处藏匿点交叉比对，那些漂流条目终于勾出一条路线——而非随机跃迁——指向"尘背"认为值得守护其土地的地方。

#en: In the flickering half-light beneath Neon's grid, the cache's data finally aligns your scattered readings, pinning his escape route to a narrow band of uncharted jumps and LIST survey gaps.  \nEverything from the dead rock, the quiet orbital anomaly, and the tampered Trade Authority logs now traces back to one methodical hand rewriting the frontier.
zh: 在霓虹城电网下方闪烁的昏光里，藏匿点的数据终于让你零散的读数对齐，把他的逃亡路线钉在一片由未测绘跃迁与独立盟勘测空白构成的狭窄地带。\n从死去的岩石、安静的轨道异常，到被动手脚的贸易管理局日志，一切如今都追溯到同一只系统性地重写边境的手。

#en: When the shard burns out, the plant's readings lurch back toward ordinary, and a buried log stream unstitches itself from the noise.  \nScrubbed coordinates reappear, half-erased callsigns flicker on the console, and one recurring vector stands out, linking the frontier tip, the Ranger records, and this refinery to a single, carefully avoided route.
zh: 碎片烧毁时，工厂的读数猛地退回寻常，一条被掩埋的日志流从噪声中自行脱线。\n被擦净的坐标重新出现，半被抹除的呼号在控制台上闪烁，一道反复出现的向量格外醒目，把边境情报、游骑兵档案与这座精炼厂连向一条被刻意避开的路。

#en: When the cache burns out, its last burst of corrupt data fans across local channels like dying embers, briefly revealing where its storm-twisting signals were relayed from.  \nIn the aftermath, scattered telemetry fragments and mismatched convoy records start pointing toward one specific stretch of sky that keeps reappearing whenever ships go missing.
zh: 藏匿点烧毁时，它最后爆出的一束损坏数据像垂死的余烬般铺满本地频道，短暂揭示出它那些扭曲风暴的信号是中继自何处。\n事后，零散的遥测碎片与对不上的运输队记录开始指向某片特定的天空——每当有船失踪，它就会再次出现。

#en: Mixed in with the Fundrunner's dead ledgers, a single route sketch contradicts every official transit map, looping from freight docks through Neon's underside toward a nameless extraction grid.  \nWhat started as a stray slate on a forgotten rock, then bad cargo math in Gagarin's bays, now aligns into one pattern of quietly redirected ships and debts.
zh: 混在资金快船的死账册里，一份路线草图与每一张官方过境图相矛盾，从货运码头绕过霓虹城的底侧，通往一张无名的采集网格。\n始于一块被遗忘岩石上的散落石板、继而是加加林星货舱里的错误货物计算的东西，如今对齐成一幅悄然改道船只与债务的图案。

#en: Hidden among the routine traffic logs, the cache stitches minor misjumps into a single geometric knot, all vectors leaning toward the same unmarked drift in deep space.  \nPlotted against the anonymous dataslate, the skewed relay, and the tales of near-misses out of Gagarin, the pattern finally resolves into a deliberate route rather than random error.
zh: 藏在例行交通日志之间，藏匿点把细小的错误跃迁缝成一个几何结，所有向量都倾向深空中同一处未标记的漂移。\n对照那块匿名数据板、歪斜的中继站和加加林星外惊险接近的传闻标绘出来，图案终于解析成一条刻意设计的路线，而非随机误差。

#en: Lines of names that should have ended at the warfront echo again in the relay's dim light, each reassignment quietly pointing toward the same forgotten staging ground.  \n\nSomeone doctored casualties at the tent outside Akila, a banker in Gagarin buried impossible payouts, and now these rerouted rosters fix the medic's trail on that silent border post.
zh: 本该止步于前线的名字，在中继站昏暗的灯光里再度回响，每一次调职都悄然指向同一处被遗忘的集结地。\n\n有人在阿基拉城外帐篷里篡改了伤亡名单，加加林星的一名银行家埋下了不可能支付的款项，如今这些改道的名册又把医护兵的行踪钉在了那座寂静的边防哨所上。

#en: Cracked seals and erased registry codes hide a fragment of nav data tucked where no SysDef inspector bothers to look, its vector just a hair off the sanctioned charts you saw dirtside.  \nFollowing that deviation means leaving the safety of patrol routes behind, chasing the same quiet anomaly that first surfaced in a forgotten cache far from any beacon.
zh: 开裂的封条与抹去的登记代码藏着一小段导航数据，塞在没有任何联殖防务检查员会费心去看的地方，它的向量与你在地表见到的制式星图只差毫厘。\n顺着这处偏差追下去，就意味着把巡逻路线的安全抛在身后，去追那处最早在远离任何信标的被遗忘藏匿点中浮现的同一桩安静异常。

#en: Cracked logs from the beacon sketch a thin, jagged line through the lanes, each waypoint matching a drive failure Calyx quietly buried or a survey ping frontier captains still whisper about.  \nWhen the pattern is overlaid on your earlier readings from the sealed lab, every vector converges on the same abandoned relay hanging alone at the system's edge.
zh: 从信标破解出的日志在航道间勾出一条细长而参差的线，每个航点都对应一次卡利克斯悄悄掩埋的引擎故障，或一次边境船长们仍在低语的勘测脉冲。\n把这图案叠加到你早先从密封实验室取得的读数上，每个向量都汇聚到星系边缘孤悬的同一座废弃中继站。

#en: Cross-referencing ship IDs and docking slots, the pattern finally surfaces: the same freighters, the same "random" delays, always steering traffic toward a quiet rendezvous outside normal patrol lanes.  \nWhat started as a stray slate in deep space and a nervous whisper at a busy port now resolves into coordinated movements serving one invisible banker.
zh: 交叉比对飞船 ID 与停靠位，图案终于浮现：同样的那些货船、同样的"随机"延误，总是把交通引向正常巡逻航线之外一次安静的会合。\n始于深空中一块散落石板和繁华港口边一句紧张低语的东西，如今解析成为某个看不见的银行家服务的协同调度。

#en: The schematic is buried deep in the factory's queue, just another pallet in an endless line, until its timing offsets and route projections match the anomalies you have been chasing.  \nIt threads the same pattern from the forgotten dataslate and the farm's quiet shipment logs, proving every detour and disappearance has been walking along her invisible path.
zh: 这张示意图深埋在工厂的队列里，只是无尽队列里的又一个货盘，直到它的时序偏移与航线预测与你一直在追的异常吻合。\n它把那块被遗忘数据板与农场安静的货运日志里的同一图案串起来，证明每一次绕行和失踪都一直沿着她那条看不见的路径行进。

#en: Rows of timestamps and route codes narrow like a noose, each quiet adjustment shunting food, fuel, and people toward the same thin slice of frontier space.  \nSeen against the remote beacon logs and the doctored records from that failed ice colony, the schedule stops looking like accounting and starts reading like a travel itinerary written in slow disasters.
zh: 一排排时间戳与航路代码像绞索般收窄，每一处安静的调整都把食物、燃料和人推向边境空间里同一片狭薄地带。\n对照那座偏远信标日志与失败冰上殖民地里被动过手脚的记录来看，这份时刻表不再像账目，而开始像一份用缓慢灾难写成的行程单。

#en: The calibration logs hidden in the mech frame point to one city where the same impossible corrections keep appearing, buried under cheap parts and dirty work orders.  \nTaken with the dust-choked dataslate from the backworld outpost and the skewed relay readings in orbit, the pattern now runs straight from Gagarin's docks into the shadows beneath Neon's glow.
zh: 藏在机甲框架里的校准日志指向一座城市，同样的不可能修正反复出现在那里，埋在廉价零件与肮脏工单底下。\n连同穷乡哨站那块积满灰尘的数据板和轨道上歪斜的中继读数一起看，图案如今从加加林星船坞笔直伸进霓虹城灯火之下的阴影。

#en: In the dead ship's flickering logs, the same three-pointed corridors that captains muttered about in Gagarin reappear, cross-referenced with Neon-side betting records and suspicious claim spikes.  \nThe pattern does not just show where he flies; it shows whose losses he has been quietly wagering on, and which lawless dens keep cashing out when his routes fail.
zh: 在死船闪烁的日志里，船长们曾在加加林星嘀咕过的那种三叉走廊再度出现，并与霓虹城一侧的投注记录和可疑的索赔激增交叉比对。\n这图案不只显示他飞向何处；它还显示他在悄悄押注谁的损失，以及哪些不法窝点在它的航线失败时不断兑现。

#en: Decoded beacon traces from the listening post show two distinct corrections branching off the same routes one trailing corporate testbeds, the other skimming forgotten relays.  \nMatched against the first ghost vectors from that derelict station and the discrepancies buried in Neon ledgers, the pattern forces a choice follow the clients, or follow the wreckage.
zh: 从监听站解码的信标痕迹显示出两处截然不同的修正，从同一条路线分岔而出——一处尾随企业试验场，另一处掠过被遗忘的中继站。\n对照那座废弃空间站最早的幽灵向量与埋在霓虹城账册里的差异，图案逼出一个选择：追委托人，还是追残骸。

#en: Pinged awake, the beacon's buried signal resolves into a single repeating vector, carving through ore-churned rock and straight toward an all-but-forgotten Deimos yard.  \nWhat looked like random ship failures and drifting hulks now share the same invisible tug, the same course correction written by a hand that understands drive tolerances too well to be chance.
zh: 被脉冲唤醒后，信标埋藏的信号解析成一道反复出现的单一向量，穿透被矿石翻搅的岩层，径直指向一座几乎被遗忘的火卫二船坞。\n看似随机的飞船故障与漂流残骸，如今共享同一只看不见的牵引手——同样的航向修正出自一只太懂引擎容差的手，绝非偶然。

#en: Decoded lines on the Blind Anchor Blueprint reshape earlier noise into a single path, its coordinates echoing those strange gaps in jump telemetry no one wanted to explain.  \n\nThe remote stash, the gutted satellite recorder, and the redacted oversight files now form one pattern, all pointing toward a hidden grav anchor where Vector vanished from official space.
zh: 《盲锚蓝图》上解码出的线条把此前的噪声重塑成一条单一路径，其坐标回响着跃迁遥测中那些没人愿意解释的奇怪空白。\n\n偏远藏匿点、被掏空的卫星记录仪，以及被涂黑的监管档案，如今构成同一个图案，全都指向一处隐秘的重力锚——"向量"在那里从官方空间中消失。

#en: The array's recordings show his ship slipping along the very edge of sensor range, always angling toward the same unmarked patch where official charts grow thin.  \nCombined with the poisoned colonies, the doctored cargo clearances, and Neon's forgotten maintenance cycles, the pattern now points outward, along a single, quiet corridor he has been using all along.
zh: 阵列的录波显示他的飞船始终贴着传感器范围的最边缘滑行，总是朝同一片官方星图逐渐稀疏的未标记区域倾斜。\n结合中毒的殖民地、被动过手脚的货物许可，以及霓虹城被遗忘的维护周期，图案如今指向外部，沿着他一直使用的那条寂静单一走廊。

#en: The ledger surfaces in a forgotten storage node on the quiet UC outpost, its altered tonnage entries lining up with missing hulls and unexplained tows.  \nMatched against earlier rumors of ghost ships and scrubbed distress calls, it points the hunt away from random piracy and toward a single rigger who has been quietly rearranging the mass of the Settled Systems.
zh: 账册浮现于安静联殖哨站一处被遗忘的存储节点中，它被篡改的吨位条目与失踪船体和无法解释的拖曳记录一一对应。\n与早先关于幽灵船和被抹除求救呼叫的传闻比对，它把追查从随机海盗行为引向一名一直在悄悄重新安排定居星系物质质量的装配工。

#en: Lines of traffic routes and disposal windows bloom across the cracked display, all bending toward a single, unlisted node in UC space, the pattern too precise to be chance or clerical error.  \nThe same hull IDs you saw buried in that orphaned buoy and half-wiped from Deimos reports reappear here, funneled through one forgotten relay like offerings to a silent ear.
zh: 一排排交通路线与处置窗口在龟裂的显示屏上绽开，全都弯向联殖空域中一个未登记的单一节点，图案精确得绝非偶然或文书错误。\n你在那座被遗弃浮标里见过、又从火卫二报告中半被抹除的同样船体 ID 在此重现，经一座被遗忘的中继站汇聚，像献给一只沉默耳朵的供品。

#en: With the last echoes from the buoy snuffed out, the noise on the scopes falls away, leaving one thin scar of traffic where there should be none.  \nCross-referenced with the poisoned settlements and that oddly clean Trade Authority clearance, the erased signal path now points toward a single, seldom-used approach that never quite lines up with official survey lanes.
zh: 随着浮标最后的回声被掐灭，显示屏上的噪声褪去，只留下交通的一道细疤，那里本不该有任何东西。\n与中毒定居点和那份异常干净的贸易管理局许可交叉比对，被抹除的信号路径如今指向一条极少使用的接近航线——它从不肯与官方勘测航道对齐。

#en: Buried in the ship's maintenance logs, you find grav-waste cycles that do not match any registered jump, all flushed toward a narrow band of coordinates tied to Neon's lower decks.  \nCross-checking with the stray data-slate, those smeared beacon returns, and the burned hauler's corrupted nav lines, the same hidden vector keeps bending back toward the city's shadows.
zh: 在飞船维护日志里，你发现与任何登记跃迁都对不上的重力废料循环，全都排向一条与霓虹城下层甲板绑定的狭窄坐标带。\n对照那块散落数据板、那些模糊的信标回波以及被烧毁运货船损坏的导航线，同一道隐秘向量一再弯回这座城市的阴影。

#en: Lines of distorted grav data straighten into a familiar pattern, and the sketch stops being theory and resolves into a route only one pilot would trust.  \nEvery mark echoes a previous anomaly you traced from deep orbit, the quiet exchanges above that farming outpost, and the field readings salvaged from shattered stone, all now pointing toward the same hidden array.
zh: 错乱的重力数据线条理直成熟悉的图案，这份草图不再是理论，而解析成一条只有某个飞行员敢信赖的路线。\n每一处标记都回响着你此前追过的异常——深空轨道上的异常、那座农场哨站上空的无声往来，以及从碎裂岩石中抢救出的实地读数，如今全都指向同一座隐秘阵列。

#en: When the beacon's signal is unraveled, two sets of coordinates resolve from the same pulse one in the cluttered rock where it hides, the other burned faintly into an old Vanguard transponder signature.  \nCross-referenced with the corporate telemetry scraped at that quiet lab, it confirms the same pilot has been riding military ghosts to thread her own invisible lanes.
zh: 当信标的信号被拆解后，两组坐标从同一脉冲中显现——一组在它藏身的杂乱岩带里，另一组淡淡烙在一个旧先锋队应答器特征中。\n与在那座安静实验室里蹭取的企业遥测交叉比对，它证实同一个飞行员一直在借军用幽灵穿引自己那条看不见的航道。

#en: Freight schematics, buried under years of ignored audits, trace a single hauler refitted for storms and low, dirty landings, its routes bending toward the same forgotten fields.  \nCross-checking those specs against the remote cache and the abandoned lab logs confirms a pattern: whenever the soil turns strange and the records vanish, that ship has passed through first.
zh: 埋在多年无人理会的审计文件下的货运示意图，勾出一艘为风暴和低空、肮脏着陆而改装的运货船，它的航线弯向同一片被遗忘的田野。\n把那些规格与偏远藏匿点、废弃实验室日志交叉核对，证实了一个规律：每当土壤变得怪异、记录凭空消失，那艘船总是率先经过。

#en: When the sample flash-boils under your fire, the containment rig vomits corrupted logs and half-erased routing tags, like the lab itself is trying to scrub its conscience clean.  \nAmong the scrambled data, one thing survives the purge a familiar hauler designation, echoed from the first hidden cache, now tied to off-manifest supply runs feeding failing frontier fields.
zh: 当样本在你的火力下瞬间沸腾时，收容装置呕出损坏的日志与半被抹除的航路标签，仿佛实验室本身也在试图洗清自己的良心。\n在混乱的数据中，有一样东西挺过了清除——一个熟悉的运货船编号，回响自第一处隐秘藏匿点，如今与喂养日渐衰败的边境田野的账外补给挂钩。

#en: Decoded at last, the Quiet Hand Routing threads every blackout you have chased into a single path, its origin jumping off the relay s map and vanishing into a dim, unregistered sector.  \nWhat looked like noise on a dead Navy freighter, what frontier settlers called bad luck, now shares the same timing, the same gaps, the same signature pulse hidden under system chatter.
zh: 《静默之手路由》终于被解码，把你追查过的每一次信号中断串成一条路径，其源头跳出中继站的地图，消失在一个昏暗、未登记的星区。\n曾被当作一艘死去海军货船上噪声的东西、被边境定居者称作坏运气的东西，如今共享着同样的时序、同样的空白、同样的藏于系统杂讯之下的特征脉冲。

#en: The recovered pathlines sketch an elegant arc through frontier systems, looping again and again past the same thin-aired worlds before bending toward one last, unnamed stop.  \nMatched against the courier drift and the garage's tampered diagnostics, the curve is unmistakable now; he has been rehearsing the same descent profile everywhere the air has quietly started to fail.
zh: 恢复的航迹线在边境星系间勾出一道优雅的弧，一次又一次绕过同样几颗空气稀薄的世界，最终弯向最后一处无名的停靠点。\n与信使的漂移数据和车库被动手脚的诊断比对，这条曲线如今已无所遁形；在每一处空气开始悄然失效的地方，他都在反复演练同一套下降剖面。

#en: Decoded against the erased tribunal models, the orbital data threads every near-miss and broken freighter into a single, ruthless trajectory that terminates in the dust outside Cydonia's reach.  \nWhat began as a redacted file in the capital and a corrupted slate on a forgotten rock now resolves into a pattern of deliberate corrections, all authored by the same unseen hand.
zh: 对照被抹除的仲裁模型解码后，轨道数据把每一次惊险接近和损坏的货船串成一条冷酷的单一轨迹，终止于赛多尼亚触及之外的尘埃中。\n始于首都一份被涂黑的档案、继而是被遗忘岩石上一块损坏石板的东西，如今解析成一幅刻意修正的图案，全都出自同一只看不见的手。

#en: Lines etched into the Graveyard Anchor Map match the twisted silhouettes drifting here, every scrapped hull suddenly a landmark on a route only one engineer could navigate.  \nWhat looked like random salvage now forms a corridor aimed squarely into that lethal debris cloud where sensor ghosts began this chase, confirming his network runs straight through the Wargrave remnants.
zh: 刻在《墓场锚地图》上的线条与在此漂流的扭曲轮廓一一吻合，每一具报废船体突然都成了只有某位工程师才导航得出的路线上的地标。\n看似随机的打捞如今构成一条笔直指向那片致命碎片云的走廊——传感器幽灵正是在那里拉开了这场追查，证实他的网络径直穿过战墓残骸。

#en: Soil readings from this backworld do not match its own survey history, a quiet spike in failure where the climate should still be forgiving.  \nCompared against that forgotten cache in the wilderness and the beacon logs from the derelict in orbit, the sample turns random misfortune into a pattern, pointing toward someone testing how far they can push a colony before it breaks.
zh: 这个穷乡世界的土壤读数与它自己的勘测历史对不上，在气候本该依旧温和之处出现一次安静的失效尖峰。\n与荒野中那处被遗忘的藏匿点、轨道上废弃物的信标日志相比对，这份样本把随机的厄运变成了一幅图案，指向有人正在试探能把一座殖民地逼到多接近崩溃。

#en: Someone on the SysDef hull tried to bury their mistakes with extra signatures and overwritten timestamps, but the pattern survived in the margins.  \nCross-referenced with the underbelly route and the tug's falsified decommission orders, the silent orbital record redraws Rivet's escape path, pointing away from official lanes toward the one place broken ships quietly go to die.
zh: 联殖防务船体上的某人曾试图用多余的签名和覆盖的时间戳掩埋自己的失误，但图案仍在页边存活下来。\n与腹地路线、拖船伪造的退役命令交叉比对，这份寂静的轨道记录重新绘出"铆钉"的逃亡路径，背离官方航道，指向破船静静赴死的那一个地方。

#en: Ghostline's altered route data resolves into a single thin corridor of space, a quiet seam he keeps threading his work through while the major lanes stay bright and busy.  \nMatched against the first stray logs from that backworld, the tampered beacon records, and the hidden schedules inside this tower, the vector stops being rumor and hardens into a narrow trail leading outward.
zh: 幽灵线被篡改的航路数据解析成一条狭薄的空域走廊，一条他在主要航道灯火通明、繁忙依旧时不断穿针引线的安静缝隙。\n与那个穷乡世界最早的散落日志、被动手脚的信标记录，以及这座塔内的隐藏时刻表比对，这向量不再是传言，而硬化成一条通向外部的小径。

#en: The log unspools like a confession, mapping a narrow band of grav-jumps that threads from forgotten wrecks straight into the sky above Neon, terminating where the city thins into lightning and antennae.  \nIt ties the empty rock where this started to falsified dock records planetside, then to a corrupted orbital trace; three broken pieces that now align into a single, rising route.
zh: 日志像一份忏悔般展开，勾出一条狭窄的重力跃迁带，从被遗忘的残骸径直穿入霓虹城上方的天空，终止于城市稀薄成闪电与天线之处。\n它把这场追查起始的那块空荡岩石、地表伪造的船坞记录，再到一段损坏的轨道痕迹串在一起；三块破碎的拼片如今对齐成一条上升的单一路线。

#en: The relay's fractured logs show two families of routes, both carrying her subtle signature and diverging from official charts at the same unmarked bend in grav space.  \nOne set traces back toward bureaucratic hands that buried her warnings; the other threads through smugglers, LIST haulers, and Neon's data peddlers, all insisting they only copied what someone else already trusted.
zh: 中继站破裂的日志显示出两族路线，都带着她那细微的特征，并在重力空间中同一个未标记的弯折处偏离官方星图。\n一族回溯到那些掩埋她警告的官僚之手；另一族穿行于走私贩、独立盟运货船和霓虹城的数据贩子之间，而他们全都坚称自己只是照抄了别人早已信任的东西。

#en: Buried under dust and fertilizer labels, the barrel's metal tells a different story fine striations from a grav field knifing too close to the surface, a pattern you have already seen burned into rock and relay data.  \nIts markings line up with that first corrupted readout in deep orbit and the quiet gap in the patrol grid, and they do not belong anywhere near a settlement this small.
zh: 埋在尘土与肥料标签之下，这只桶的金属讲述着另一个故事——一道重力场过于贴近地表掠过留下的细密条纹，一种你已在岩石和中继数据中见过并烙下的图案。\n它的标记与深空轨道上那份最早的损坏读数、以及巡逻网格中那处安静的空白对齐，而它们绝不该出现在这么小的定居点附近。

#en: The ship's forgotten diagnostics carry more truth than its pristine cargo logs.  \nHidden among years of routine runs, a single route trace diverts through the same drifting coordinates the array broadcast, matching the anomalous readings pulled from the rock and the research station, tightening the circle around one navigator who keeps rewriting how ships move without asking permission.
zh: 飞船被遗忘的诊断记录，比它那些光洁的货运日志承载着更多真相。\n藏在多年例行航次中的一条航迹改道，穿过了阵列广播的那同一组漂移坐标，与从岩石和研究站提取的异常读数吻合，把圆圈收紧到一个不断改写飞船运作方式、却从不请求许可的领航员身上。

#en: Decoded against the drift of distant moons, the routes etched here line up perfectly with the gaps in official patrol coverage and those quiet LIST survey holes no one admits approving.  \nTogether with the dead settlers' logs, the warped orbital readings, and the scrubbed cargo manifests, this pattern confirms a single hand threading the same unseen corridors between every ruined colony.
zh: 对照远方卫星的漂移解码后，这里刻画的路线与官方巡逻覆盖的空白、以及那些没人承认批准过的安静独立盟勘测空洞完美对齐。\n连同死去定居者的日志、扭曲的轨道读数和被擦净的货运舱单，这图案证实同一只手在每一座毁灭的殖民地之间穿引同样的看不见的走廊。

#en: The packet is a stitched-together echo of field reports and med-traffic, a ghost of someone quietly rerouting help where official channels refused to see a problem.  \nThreaded through the corrupted entries are repeating timestamps, coordinates, and unit tags that match old decommission orders, all converging on one forgotten muster point the next place she keeps going back to in the dark.
zh: 这份数据包是野战报告与医疗通讯缝在一起的回声，某个人的幽灵——他在官方渠道拒绝承认问题存在之处悄然改道救援。\n贯穿那些损坏条目的是反复出现的时间戳、坐标和部队标签，它们与旧的退役命令吻合，全都汇聚到一处被遗忘的集结地——她下一个不断在黑暗中折返的地方。

#en: The recovered lattice fragment hums softly in the lightless recess of The Well, stitching traffic ghosts into a single, deliberate pattern that all bends back toward the same buried node beneath New Atlantis.  \nEvery altered corridor, every falsified ping, resolves into one inevitable convergence point: the place where Luna stopped hiding behind ships and started rewiring the city itself.
zh: 被找回的格栅碎片在深井区无光的深处低声嗡鸣，把交通幽灵缝成一幅刻意设计的单一图案，全都弯回新亚特兰蒂斯城之下同一个被掩埋的节点。\n每一条被篡改的走廊、每一次伪造的脉冲，都解析成一个必然的汇聚点：那是露娜不再躲在飞船之后、而开始重写城市本身的地方。

#en: The scrap-stained junction from Akila's back alleys appears again in the Trustsphere's nav logs, not as junk but as a reference point buried inside a chain of "corrected" jumps.  \nCross-referencing those timings with the ship's protection routes sketches a faint, skewed corridor outward, suggesting whoever bent these lanes thinks in rust, wreckage, and places the insurers stopped watching.
zh: 阿基拉城后巷那处沾满废料的交汇点在信球的导航日志中再度出现，它不是垃圾，而是埋在一串"修正"跃迁中的一个参照点。\n把那些时序与飞船的护航路线交叉比对，勾出一条向外延伸、微弱而歪斜的走廊，暗示把这些航线弯折的人，思考的是锈蚀、残骸，以及保险公司不再注视的地方。

#en: Someone had already started pulling his access traces apart out here, in the middle of nowhere, then walked away mid-line like a hand jerked off a hot coil.  \nWhat is left links the frozen colony's broken signals, the doctored beacon in orbit, and the tampered queue records below the city into a single repeating signature, each step tightening the circle around the same absent coordinator.
zh: 有人已经在这前不着村后不着店之地开始拆解他的访问痕迹，然后做到一半就走开了，像一只手猛地从滚烫的线圈上抽回。\n留下的东西把冰封殖民地破碎的信号、轨道上被动手脚的信标，以及城市下方被篡改的队列记录连成同一个反复出现的特征，每一步都收紧圆圈，围绕同一个缺席的协调员。

#en: The routechart overlays Neon's traffic grid with ghost corridors that never officially existed, each line ending in the same tangle of scrap and shadow beneath the city lights.  \nReading it, you see how every falsified beacon, every doctored manifest, bends here through unregistered lanes and discarded hulls, just as the first anonymous dataslate and the freightyard records hinted it might.
zh: 这份航路图在霓虹城的交通网格上叠加了从未正式存在过的幽灵走廊，每条线都终止于城市灯火之下同一团废料与阴影里。\n读着它，你会看到每一座伪造信标、每一份被动过手脚的舱单，都在此弯折，穿过未登记的航道与被丢弃的船体，正如第一块匿名数据板和货运场记录曾暗示的那样。

#en: In the quiet drift above the world, a single data burst repeats against the static, flagged only by subtle changes in pressure cycles no one was meant to notice.  \nDecoded beside the ledger you stole from the tower high over Neon's streets, it exposes the same timing, the same missing minutes; his adjustments to the air have always been rehearsed in orbit before he risks a settlement's sky.
zh: 在世界上方安静的漂移中，一束数据在静电中反复出现，仅由气压循环里细微、无人该察觉的变化标示出来。\n与你从霓虹城街道高处那座塔里偷来的账册并排解码，它暴露出同样的时序、同样缺失的几分钟；他对空气的调整，总在冒着风险闯入某座定居点天空之前，先在轨道上演练过。

#en: Cracking the cache peels back a thin layer of automation, revealing a quiet stack of override codes and route masks all converging on the same off-chart coordinate.  \nIt matches the erratic shipment timings whispered over coffee, the strange supply pattern out at the farm, and the forgotten patrol logs still watching restricted air, turning scattered anomalies into a single deliberate path.
zh: 破解藏匿点揭开薄薄一层自动化，露出一叠安静的覆盖代码与航路掩码，全都汇聚到同一个图外坐标。\n它与喝咖啡时低语的异常出货时序、那座农场外奇怪的补给模式，以及仍在监视禁飞空域的被遗忘巡逻日志吻合，把零散的异常变成一条刻意设计的路径。

#en: The shattered wreck's flight logs show the same impossible mid-course twist that's been haunting incident reports, only this time the correction vector doesn't vanish into noise.  \nPlotted alongside the lonely outpost's data spike and those first skewed readings in high orbit, the debris' last turn points cleanly toward a new patch of empty coordinates that suddenly doesn't look empty at all.
zh: 碎裂残骸的飞行日志显示出那份一直萦绕在事故报告里的、不可能的中途扭转，只是这一次修正向量没有消失进噪声里。\n与孤零零哨站的数据尖峰、以及高轨道上最早那些歪斜读数并排标绘，残骸最后的那次转向干净利落地指向一片崭新的空坐标——它忽然看上去一点也不空了。

#en: Cracked open in zero-g, the manifest spills routes and timestamps like blood, every "random" accident lining up along the same thin corridor at the edge of mapped space.  \nCross-referencing its ports of call and falsified UC clearances with the logs pulled from that dead surface relay, one truth holds the same unseen hand has been nudging ships toward the same cold, forgotten margins for years.
zh: 在零重力中撬开，舱单像血一样溅出航线与时间戳，每一起"随机"事故都沿着制图空间边缘同一条狭薄走廊排列。\n把它的停靠港与伪造的联殖许可，与从地表那座死中继站提取的日志交叉比对，一个真相成立：同一只看不见的手多年来一直在把飞船推向同样寒冷、被遗忘的边缘。

#en: Buried in the outpost's failing systems, the log lists substrate trials tied to coordinates that keep circling the same quiet sensor anomaly in deep space.  \nThe entries echo patterns from the altered homestead, the drifting beacon, and the courier's crooked routes, turning this forgotten terminal into the first clear pointer toward where their controlled ecosystem might already be taking root.
zh: 埋在哨站失灵的系统里，日志列出的基质试验绑定着不断环绕深空中同一处安静传感器异常的坐标。\n这些条目回响着来自被篡改的农场聚落、漂移信标以及信使弯曲航线的图案，把这台被遗忘的终端变成第一个清晰的指针，指向他们受控的生态系统可能已经扎根的地方。

#en: Buried in the ship's forgotten logs, the loading chart shows the same battered freighters diverting from patrol space to the same storm-lit docks beneath the city again and again.  \nWhat started as a lonely outpost report and an orphaned orbital cache now aligns with a SysDef hull's altered routes, all pointing toward those shadowed decks where Torque's friends, buyers, or backdoors are waiting.
zh: 埋在飞船被遗忘的日志里，装载图表显示同样几艘破旧货船一次又一次从巡逻空域改道，驶向城市之下同样被风暴照亮的船坞。\n始于一份孤独哨站报告和一处被遗弃轨道藏匿点的东西，如今与一具联殖防务船体被篡改的航线对齐，全都指向那些阴影笼罩的甲板——"扭矩"的朋友、买家或后门正在那里等候。

#en: Pages of dirty numbers tie "lost" manifests to the same stretch of darkened lanes, the same timing gaps no traffic officer will admit seeing.  \nPut beside the stray slate from that dead rock and the uneasy stories from freight hands, the ledger turns rumor into a pattern: certain hauls were never meant to reach port, and whoever diverted them keeps orbiting the same invisible crossroads in space.
zh: 一页页肮脏的数字把"失踪"的舱单系向同一片昏暗的航道、同样的时序空白，没有哪个交通官肯承认见过。\n与那块死岩石上散落的石板、货运工人们不安的讲述放在一起，这本账册把传言变成一幅图案：某些货载本就注定到不了港，而改道它们的人，一直盘旋在太空中同一个看不见的十字路口。

#en: Parsed against old convoy records, the Split Beacon Telemetry shows every altered route fanning out in two directions, like a wound that never healed straight.  \nOne branch drifts toward corporate lanes that never appear on public charts, the other leans into neglected frontier traffic where missing ships are written off as bad luck, forcing the hunter to choose which shadow Vector walks in next.
zh: 对照旧运输队记录解析后，《分岔信标遥测》显示每一条被篡改的路线都朝两个方向散开，像一道从未愈合整齐的伤口。\n一支漂向从未出现在公开星图上的企业航道，另一支倾入被忽视的边境交通——那里的失踪船只被记为坏运气，迫使猎人选择"向量"下一步走在哪一道影子里。

#en: Shattered fragments of the chart still whisper on nearby relays, resolving into a single, off-axis corridor shared by every altered manifest and falsified patrol you have seen.  \nIt threads from the lost freighter's impossible detour and that first stray dataslate in deep space straight toward one quiet sector on the edge of known lanes, where a mobile habitat keeps slipping between jurisdictions.
zh: 星图的碎裂残片仍在附近的中继站上低语，解析成一条偏离轴线的单一走廊，你见过的每一份被篡改舱单与伪造巡逻都共享着它。\n它从失踪货船那不可能完成的绕行，以及深空中第一块散落数据板一路穿引，径直指向已知航道边缘一个安静的星区——那里有一座移动居所不断在各管辖区之间滑移。

#en: When the transport's archived sensor feed flickers alive, the strange grav echo repeats the same impossible heading, weaving through dead corridors and abandoned arrays.  \nCross-referencing earlier data pulls the signature straight through that off-the-books relay everyone pretends was decommissioned, turning scattered suspicions from the rock and the research post into a single, undeniable vector.
zh: 当运输船存档的传感器馈送重新闪烁亮起时，那道奇怪的重力回声重复着同一个不可能完成的航向，在死去的走廊与废弃阵列间穿行。\n与早先的数据交叉比对，这个特征径直穿过所有人都假装已退役的那座账外中继站，把来自那块岩石和研究哨站的零散怀疑汇成一道无可否认的向量。

#en: They trace the hidden wiring through dusty rafters and rusted conduit, watching farm machinery pause in perfect rhythm with passing orbital traffic.  \nWhen the last panel opens and the uplink's narrow-beam logs spill out, a single repeating coordinate surfaces again  the same pattern hinted at by the stray dataslate on that lonely rock and the whispers of impossible delivery times in distant ports.
zh: 他们顺着布满灰尘的椽木与锈蚀的线管追踪隐秘的线路，看着农场机械以与掠过轨道交通完美合拍的节奏停顿。\n当最后一块面板打开、上行链路窄波束日志倾泻而出时，一个反复出现的坐标再度浮现——正是那块孤独岩石上的散落数据板、以及遥远港口中关于不可能送达时刻的低语所暗示的同一图案。

#en: The cache lies half-buried in dust and forgotten sensor wire, exactly where a clerk tired of asking questions would stop looking.  \nInside, mismatched foreclosure notices, scrubbed bounty drafts, and a handful of anonymized transfer traces all point away from this quiet rock toward busier skies, where traffic, terminals, and corporate hands are thick enough to hide one very precise ghost among them.
zh: 藏匿点半埋在尘土与被遗忘的传感器线缆中，恰在一个厌倦了追问的文书会停下搜寻的地方。\n里面，对不上的止赎通知、被擦净的悬赏草稿，以及一小把匿名转账痕迹，全都背离这块安静岩石，指向更繁忙的天空——那里的交通、终端与企业之手稠密得足以在其中藏下一个极其精确的幽灵。

#en: The data rippled like sediment in a glass, every name and number from the queues below settling into a faint, repeating curve that did not belong to any sanctioned route.  \nRun through a nav plotter, that curve becomes a corridor pointing away from licensed colonies and toward the same off grid pocket every altered farm log, abandoned homestead, and broken survey jump has been quietly circling around.
zh: 数据像杯中沉渣般荡漾，来自下方队列的每一个名字与数字都沉降成一道微弱、反复出现的曲线，而它不属于任何制式航线。\n经导航绘图仪处理，那条曲线变成一条走廊，背离持照殖民地，指向同一个离网口袋——每一份被篡改的农场日志、每一座被弃的农场聚落、每一次断裂的勘测跃迁，都一直在悄悄环绕它。

#en: The cache goes up in a silent flare, and with it the last of its scrambled broadcasts, but not before your systems rip a single pattern from the wreckage.  \nBuried under decoys and looped telemetry lies a chain of altered buoy IDs, all pointing back toward a forgotten UC ear on the edge of the same corridor, where someone has been quietly rewriting the sky while official charts swear nothing is there.
zh: 藏匿点在无声的闪光中炸毁，连同它最后那些混乱的广播，可你的系统仍在一切湮灭之前从残骸中撕出一个完整的图案。\n埋在诱饵与循环遥测之下的，是一串被篡改的浮标 ID，全都指回同一走廊边缘一只被遗忘的联殖耳朵——有人一直在那里悄悄改写天空，而官方星图却发誓那里什么也没有。

#en: When the construct ruptured, its last transmission stitched together every altered delay code you have chased, converging them on a single sealed facility in failing orbit.  \nFor the first time, the pattern answers back, pointing from scattered whispers in dead space, a corrupted courier, and a scrubbed Navy log straight to the deserted biotics lab hanging like a forgotten thought above the world below.
zh: 当构造体爆裂时，它最后的传输把你追查过的每一个被篡改延误代码缝合起来，汇聚到一座处于衰败轨道中的密封设施上。\n图案第一次回话了，从死寂太空中的零散低语、一名堕落的信使，到一份被擦净的海军日志，径直指向那座废弃的生物实验室——它像一缕被遗忘的思绪，悬在下方世界的头顶。

#en: The ledger cross-checks SysDef contract IDs against off-book payments from Neon, drawing a clean, illegal line between corporate rooftops and a navigator selling impossible exits.  \nPinned alongside the drift logs and that jittery clerk's forged permits, it turns scattered rumors into a pattern: the same signature routes, the same one-jump-too-far coordinates, always circling the same hidden destination.
zh: 账册把联殖防务合同 ID 与来自霓虹城的账外付款交叉核对，在企业楼顶与一名兜售不可能出口的领航员之间画出一条干净而不合法的线。\n与漂移日志、那位神经紧张文书的伪造许可钉在一起，它把零散传言变成一幅图案：同样的特征航线、同样的过远一步的坐标，总是环绕同一个隐秘目的地。

#en: When the relay finally goes dark, the traffic lanes around it look cleaner and more honest on the scope, like someone wiped a greasy fingerprint off the glass.  \nThe residual logs carry just enough echo to show where the tampered handoffs were pushing ships, and those vectors line up disturbingly well with the frozen colony's last calls and the backworld where survey data went missing for no good reason.
zh: 当中继站终于熄灭时，周围航道在示波器上显得更干净、更诚实，像有人擦掉了玻璃上的油腻指纹。\n残留日志带着刚好足够的回声，显示出被动手脚的交接正在把飞船推向何处，而那些向量与冰封殖民地最后的呼叫、以及那份毫无理由失踪勘测数据的穷乡世界的吻合程度令人不安。

#en: Spliced into the relay's dying systems, the manifolds redraw the map for a heartbeat, revealing a faint corridor where normal traffic never runs.  \nFor the first time, the scattered hints line up: the mislogged ping from that forgotten rock, the partial route data from the quiet lab, and the unexplained double-echo off this very station, all pointing toward a stretch of space charts politely leave blank.
zh: 接入中继站垂死的系统后，歧管在一个心跳的时间里重绘地图，显露出一条正常交通从不经过的微弱走廊。\n零散的线索第一次对齐：来自那块被遗忘岩石的错误登记脉冲、来自安静实验室的部分航路数据，以及这座空间站本身莫名其妙的双重回声，全都指向一片星图礼貌地留作空白的空域。

#en: Telemetry from the drifting array traces invisible lines through deep orbit, stitching wreck-fields, smugglers' waypoints, and one wandering gas giant into a single repeating pattern.  \nCross-referenced with the dataslate from the backwater rock and the crooked dock times near Neon, it proves someone has been quietly bending whole shipping corridors around a hidden node that nobody ever mentions by name.
zh: 来自漂移阵列的遥测在深空轨道中勾出看不见的线条，把残骸场、走私贩的航点和一颗游荡的气态巨行星缝成同一个反复出现的图案。\n与来自穷乡岩石的数据板、霓虹城附近歪斜的船坞时刻交叉比对，它证明有人一直在悄悄把整条航运走廊绕着一个没人敢点名的隐秘节点弯折。

#en: The core's output logs smear Helium-3 flows across star charts and balance sheets alike, every tiny correction pointing not to safety, but to a single, calculated blind spot in patrol coverage.  \nCross-referenced with the altered manifests from that moonside relay, the same pattern emerges again and again, all vectors narrowing toward one forgotten refinery where risk, profit, and disappearance intersect.
zh: 核心的输出日志把氦-3 流量涂抹在星图与资产负债表上，每一处微小的修正都不是指向安全，而是指向巡逻覆盖范围中一个经过精确计算的盲点。\n与那座卫星侧中继站被篡改的舱单交叉比对，同样的图案一次次浮现，所有向量都收窄到一座被遗忘的精炼厂——风险、利润与失踪在那里交汇。

#en: Each altered route recorded here links freighters, patrols, and smugglers into a single looping pattern, always brushing past the same quiet corner of space.  \nReading it alongside the dead dataslate, the compromised courier logs, Navy timing gaps, and the buried schedules from New Atlantis, the hunt no longer feels like scattered accidents but a deliberate lattice narrowing toward one last, unseen window.
zh: 这里记录的每一条被篡改路线，都把货船、巡逻与走私贩连成一个循环往复的图案，总是擦过太空中同一个安静的角落。\n与那块死数据板、被攻陷的信使日志、海军时序空白，以及新亚特兰蒂斯城埋藏的时刻表并读，这场追查不再像零散的事故，而像一张刻意编织的格栅，收窄指向最后一扇看不见的窗口。

#en: The samples pulled from this forgotten outpost are wrong in exactly the same way as the creatures that stopped behaving like anything native back on that first homestead.  \nThe growth curves echo the readings from the crippled beacon in orbit, and the residue markers match traces found in the courier's tampered cargo bay, turning this dusty lab into the missing hinge between field tests and full deployments.
zh: 从这座被遗忘哨站取回的样本，错得与最初那座农场聚落上不再像任何本土生物的东西一模一样。\n生长曲线回响着轨道上那座受损信标的读数，残留标记与在信使被动手脚的货舱里发现的痕迹吻合，把这间积灰的实验室变成实地测试与全面部署之间那枚缺失的铰链。

#en: When the log core ruptured, its last burst carried a jagged echo of jump data, a half-burned trail pointing not to a colony or lane, but to an unnamed patch of deep space.  \nCross-checking that fragment against the abandoned homestead's anomalies and the crippled satellite's corrupted readings, the same empty coordinate window keeps surfacing, like someone has been circling one dark star for a very long time.
zh: 当日志核心爆裂时，它最后的一束爆发带着一道参差的跃迁数据回声，一条烧焦一半的踪迹，不指向任何殖民地或航道，而指向深空中一片无名的区域。\n把这块碎片与废弃农场聚落的异常、受损卫星损坏的读数交叉核对，同一扇空坐标窗口不断浮现，仿佛有人已经围绕某颗暗星盘旋了非常久。

#en: Pulling its recordings apart is like unbraiding static, but beneath the noise a handful of jumps repeat, always bending toward the same forgotten transfer hub at the edge of regulated space.  \nEvery altered route you traced from the wrecked hauler and the buried war-room logs aligns with those echoes now, sketching the outline of a quiet cargo depot that has no business handling that much unregistered traffic.
zh: 把它的录波拆开，就像解开一团绞缠的静电，但在噪声之下有一小把跃迁反复出现，总是弯向受管制空域边缘同一座被遗忘的转运枢纽。\n你从毁坏的运货船与埋藏的作战室日志中追出的每一条被篡改路线，如今都与那些回声对齐，勾出一座安静货运站的轮廓——它本不该经手那么多未登记的交通。

#en: When the last subroutine on the grid finally collapses, its dying pulses stitch together waypoints that were never supposed to share the same channel.  \nOut of the noise, a crooked corridor emerges: the same misfiled ping from that forgotten rock, the corrupted timing from the quiet lab, and the double-echo from the old relay, all bending toward one stretch of space where ships keep arriving lighter than they left.
zh: 当电网上的最后一个子程序终于崩溃时，它垂死的脉冲把本不该共享同一频道的航点缝在一起。\n从噪声中浮现出一条弯曲走廊：来自那块被遗忘岩石的错误归档脉冲、来自安静实验室的损坏时序，以及来自旧中继站的双重回声，全都弯向一片空域——那里的飞船总是到得比离开时更轻。

#en: When the coded lattice burns out, the depot goes oddly quiet; for the first time, the routing consoles stop trying to "correct" local grav readings and simply show where ships have actually vanished.  \nIn the static that follows, an unmasked pattern of jump vectors emerges, all converging toward the same forgotten Cheyenne-side test corridor you first heard about in half-redacted freight reports and nervous bar talk.
zh: 当编码格栅烧毁后，仓库诡异地安静下来；航路控制台第一次不再试图"修正"本地重力读数，只是如实显示飞船究竟在哪里消失。\n在随之而来的静电中，一幅被揭下面具的跃迁向量图案浮现，全都汇聚到夏延星一侧同一条被遗忘的试验走廊——你最初是在半被涂黑的货运报告和紧张的酒吧闲谈里听说的。

#en: Shipment schedules and payment codes, buried under orders for coolant and cheap liquor, show the same clusters of worlds paying for "special calibration services" at odd hours.  \nThe ledger ties those quiet transactions to reactor spikes at the refinery and to red-flagged reports at the frontier post, turning scattered rumors about off-the-books weather work into a single chain of repeat customers she keeps circling.
zh: 埋在冷却液与廉价烈酒订单之下的出货时刻表与付款代码，显示出同样几簇世界在古怪的时段为"特殊校准服务"付费。\n这本账册把那些安静的交易与精炼厂的反应堆尖峰、边境哨所被标红的报告系在一起，把关于账外气象作业的零散传闻变成一串她不断环绕的回头客名单。

#en: The key s fractured codes overlay the relay s traffic like a double exposure, one band bending back toward crowded corporate lanes, the other bleeding into thin frontier beacons.  \nEvery frequency tag matches what you pulled from the dead Navy freighter, the scrubbed audit chain, and the whispered payments to backwater clinics, forcing a choice between chasing the buyers of silence or the people who keep surviving it.
zh: 钥匙破碎的代码像双重曝光一样叠在中继站的交通上，一带弯回拥挤的企业航道，另一带渗入稀疏的边境信标。\n每一个频率标签都与从死去海军货船、被擦净的审计链，以及付给穷乡诊所的低语款项中提取的东西吻合，逼你在追查沉默的买家，还是追查一再从沉默中活下来的人之间做出选择。

#en: Shredded fragments of the chart fall across the relay's dusty consoles, and for a moment the holo-projection holds, bleeding its last: a cluster of drifting wrecks, then a single distant orbit traced again and again like a fixation.  \nCross-checking with the corrupted logs you pulled earlier, the pattern is clear now every falsified update, every "corrected" route was bending traffic toward that same cold, outer system.
zh: 星图的碎裂残片散落在中继站积灰的控制台上，全息投影有一瞬间稳住了，淌出它最后的内容：一簇漂流的残骸，随后是一条孤悬远方的轨道，被像执念一样一遍遍描画。\n与你早先提取的损坏日志交叉核对，图案如今清晰了——每一次伪造的更新、每一条"修正"过的航线，都在把交通弯向同一个寒冷的外围星系。

#en: Each entry in the ledger traces a quiet rerouting of freighters and patrol boats, curving their paths away from official docks toward the same unlogged rendezvous points in hostile orbits.  \nCross-referenced with the first outpost report and the orphaned cache in empty space, the altered SysDef patterns finally align into a single, repeating arc that narrows the hunt from rumor to a small handful of very specific shadows.
zh: 账册中每一条记录都追出一批货船与巡逻艇的悄然改道，把它们从官方船坞引开，弯向敌对轨道中同样的未登记会合点。\n与第一份哨站报告和空无一物的太空里那处被遗弃的藏匿点交叉比对，被篡改的联殖防务图案终于对齐成一条反复出现的单一弧线，把追查从传言收窄到寥寥几道非常具体的影子。

#en: When the array ruptures, the last burst of telemetry you salvaged sketches a thin, crooked vein through otherwise empty space, a corridor that keeps brushing dangerously close to the same distant system.  \nThe earlier slate on that forgotten rock, the first mismatched beacon returns, and now this broken watcher all whisper the same thing: Vector is not jumping blind, he is rehearsing a route toward whatever waits out there.
zh: 当阵列爆裂时，你抢救出的最后一束遥测在本应空无一物的太空中勾出一条细长弯曲的脉络，一条不断危险地贴近同一个遥远星系的走廊。\n那块被遗忘岩石上更早的石板、最早对不上的信标回波，如今再加上这名损坏的守望者，都在低语着同一件事："向量"不是在盲目跃迁，他正在反复演练一条通往那里某个等待之物的路线。

#en: Each scratched route and off-hour departure on the schedule mirrors a half-remembered rumor, drawing invisible lines between frontier farms, back-alley clinics, and quiet ports no customs officer watches.  \nFollowed together, those lines turn the stray slate from the rock, the altered manifests at Gagarin, and the whispered descriptions of a soft-spoken courier into a single, repeating pattern pointing toward her next jump.
zh: 时刻表上每一条被划掉的航线与每一个非正常时段离港，都映照着一则记忆模糊的传闻，在边境农场、后巷诊所与没有海关官员注视的安静港口之间画出看不见的线。\n把这些线串起来看，来自那块岩石的散落石板、加加林星上被篡改的舱单，以及关于一名轻声细语信使的低语描述，便汇成一幅反复出现的单一图案，指向她的下一次跃迁。

#en: Decoded at last, the Ghost Channel Log lays a second pattern over the starlanes, tracing every falsified route back to one silent node that never appears on current charts.  \nCross-referenced with the fractured data from the drifting buoy and the half-wiped records pulled from UC monitoring, it proves Vector has been bouncing his work through the same forgotten relay, stepping closer to it with each disaster and cover story.
zh: 《幽灵频道日志》终于被解码，在星航道上叠加出第二幅图案，把每一条伪造路线追溯回一个从不出现于当前星图的沉默节点。\n与来自漂移浮标的碎裂数据、以及从联殖监测中提取的半被抹除记录交叉比对，它证明"向量"一直通过同一座被遗忘的中继站中转自己的作品，随着每一场灾难与每一套掩饰说法，一步步向它逼近。

#en: In the Clinic's dim archive wing, the pattern hidden in the schema finally stops looking like random medical noise and starts echoing the same warped vectors found in old war sims and freighter logs.  \nNow the trail threads together the remote rock's corrupted slate, the altered ship manifests, and that buried military dataset into a single, repeating lattice pointing away from known routes and deeper into the quiet between.
zh: 在星际诊所号昏暗的档案翼楼里，藏在图解中的图案终于不再像随机的医疗噪声，而开始回响着在旧战时模拟与货船日志中发现的同样扭曲向量。\n如今这条线索把遥远岩石上损坏的石板、被篡改的飞船舱单，以及那批被掩埋的军方数据集串成一座反复出现的格栅，背离已知航线，深入航线之间的寂静。

#en: The manifest lists ships that officially never left dock, flight plans that were edited, then erased, and a repeating string of grav coordinates tied to loss reports no one dared file properly. Cross-referenced with the distorted jump angles and rooftop guidance data, it stops being an accounting error and becomes a map: every falsified departure, every vanished hull, all arcing toward the same off-chart convergence in deep space.
zh: 舱单列出官方记录中从未离港的船只、被编辑后又被抹除的飞行计划，以及一串与没人敢妥善存档的损失报告绑定的反复重力坐标。与扭曲的跃迁角度和屋顶导航数据交叉比对，它不再是一处账目错误，而成了一张地图：每一次伪造的离港、每一具消失的船体，全都弯向深空中同一个图外汇聚点。

#en: Buried in Ryujin's restricted archives, the index quietly stitches together censored route data, missing freighters, and contracts scrubbed from public ledgers.  \n\nIt does not name Vector, but it flags the same anomalous jump pattern attached to backwater distress calls and a drifting cutter's corrupted logs, hinting that someone inside Neon's corporate tower has been buying passage along corridors no official chart admits exist.
zh: 埋在龙神受限的档案里，这份索引悄然把被审查的航路数据、失踪的货船，以及从公开账册中擦除的合同缝在一起。\n\n它没有点出"向量"的名字，却标出了与穷乡求救呼叫和一艘漂流快艇损坏日志绑定的同一个异常跃迁图案，暗示霓虹城企业塔内有某个人一直在沿着任何官方星图都不承认存在的走廊购买通行权。

#en: The schema ties half-legal firmware tweaks from Gagarin's rusting factories to the same fractional course shifts seen in frontier misjumps, each edit stamped with a familiar compression pattern.  \nLayered over the dust-salvaged dataslate and the crooked readings from that forgotten orbital relay, it stops looking like random corruption and starts to resemble a single hand quietly redrafting the lanes from one backwater port outward.
zh: 这份图解把加加林星生锈工厂里半合法的固件改动，与边境错误跃迁中出现的同样微小航向偏移系在一起，每一处编辑都盖着一个熟悉的压缩图案印章。\n叠到从尘土中抢救出的数据板、以及那座被遗忘轨道中继站歪斜的读数之上，它不再像随机的损坏，而开始像一只手从一座穷乡港口向外悄悄重绘航道。

#en: Someone etched the route where only a breaker would look, hidden in the pattern of cut plates and welded braces, a quiet answer to the question of where he runs when every lane closes. The drift marked here matches the dead vectors traced in that forgotten relay and the half wiped path encoded on the first dataslate, turning scattered rumors of a haunted graveyard into a single, deliberate heading toward the hulks he still calls home.
zh: 有人把这条路线刻在只有拆船工才会去看的地方，藏在切割钢板与焊接支架的纹样里，安静地回答了他每当所有航道关闭时逃往何处的问题。这里标记的漂移与那座被遗忘中继站里追踪到的死向量、以及第一块数据板上编码的半被抹除路径吻合，把关于闹鬼墓场的零散传闻汇成一个刻意的单一航向，指向那些他仍称作家的残骸。

#en: Rust-stained lines, drawn by someone who never left the soil, mirror Neon's power veins and mark where they fall dark before official logs say they should.  \nLaid beside earlier scraps from a forgotten outpost and the freight records pulled off that derelict depot, the pattern finally holds: wrecks vanish along the same hidden corridors, always after the same unlogged power flickers, always with the same unregistered tug just out of frame.
zh: 锈迹斑斑的线条出自一个从未离开过土地的人之手，映照着霓虹城的电力脉络，标出它们在官方日志所说的时间之前就已经变暗之处。\n与来自一座被遗忘哨站的更早碎片、以及从废弃仓库提取的货运记录并排放置，图案终于成立：残骸沿同样的隐秘走廊消失，总在同样未登记的电力闪烁之后，总有一艘同样未登记的拖船恰好停在画面之外。

#en: Lines of corrupted entries flicker, then resolve into a single intact route code, slipped between mundane repairs and routine injuries like a heartbeat hiding in static.  \n\nWhoever patched that mechanic has used this trick before; the same clipped shorthand points away from this garage toward a gambler's infirmary that orders far more chems than it declares, and a derelict hospital hulk where the handwriting first shows up in sealed UC reports.
zh: 一排排损坏的条目闪烁不定，随后解析成一个完好的航路代码，夹在平凡的维修与例行伤情之间，像藏在静电里的心跳。\n\n给那名技工打过补丁的人以前就用过这个把戏；同样的简写指向远离这间车库之处——一座订购的药剂远超其申报量的赌徒医务室，以及一具废弃的医院残骸，那里的笔迹最早出现在被封存的联殖报告中。

#en: The listening post is dead to official traffic, but its dishes were never retuned; they still drink from the same blind angles where her altered jump corridors pass like ghosts. Buried in the old logs, the chart ties wrecked convoys, falsified distress calls, and that gutted scrapyard together on a single looping route, finally showing that her detours are not random at all but a deliberate spiral toward something hidden off every sanctioned map.
zh: 这座监听站对官方交通而言已死，但它的天线从未被重新调谐；它们仍在从同样的盲区汲取——她那些被篡改的跃迁走廊正像幽灵般从那里经过。埋在旧日志里的星图把毁坏的运输队、伪造的求救呼叫和那座被掏空的废料场系在一条循环路线上，终于显示出她的绕行完全不是随机的，而是一道刻意旋向某种藏于每张制式星图之外的螺旋。

#en: The node's memory is scorched and half its antennas blind, but what is left of the navigation buffer still holds a lattice of course corrections that never went to any registered colony.  \nLayered over the timing records from the queues and the diverted shipments you traced through Neon and HopeTown, those faint vectors all lean toward the same blank patch of sky, tightening the hunt from rumor and coincidence into a single, unmarked destination.
zh: 节点的存储被烧焦，一半天线失明，但导航缓冲区剩下的部分仍保存着一座航向修正的格栅，而这些修正从未送往任何登记殖民地。\n叠到来自队列的时序记录、以及你穿过霓虹城和霍普镇追踪到的改道出货之上，那些微弱的向量全都倾向同一片空白天空，把追查从传言与巧合收紧到一个未标记的单一目的地。

#en: The overlay redraws Cydonia's shipping lanes like veins under a scanner, exposing one recurring route that never appears on official boards yet always departs just after "emergency" shipments clear customs.  \nCompared against the dirty manifest fragments from the rock and the broker's doctored lists back in Neon, the same phantom convoy emerges each time, hugging the edge of corporate intake zones before vanishing toward an unregistered rendezvous.
zh: 这层叠加图把赛多尼亚的航运航道像扫描仪下的血管一样重绘，露出一条反复出现的路线——它从不出现于官方公告板，却总在"紧急"货物清关后立刻启程。\n与来自那块岩石的肮脏舱单碎片、以及霓虹城里那名经纪商被动过手脚的清单相比对，同一支幽灵运输队每次都浮现，紧贴企业收货区的边缘，随后消失驶向一处未登记的会合点。

#en: The flight path recorded here bends around the established lanes in the same crooked arc you saw whispered through docking records on Jemison, skipping patrol grids and threading through old war debris like someone knows exactly where the blind spots live. Cross-referenced with wreck reports and that stripped yard, the approach repeats with different ship IDs, different captains, always curving toward the same quiet patch of space that never shows on official charts.
zh: 这里记录的飞行路径以一道弯曲的弧绕过既有航道——正是你在杰米森星停靠记录里听人低语过的那道弧，它跳过巡逻网格，穿过旧战争残骸，仿佛有人对盲点所在了如指掌。与残骸报告和那座被拆空的船坞交叉比对，这条接近航线反复出现，船体 ID 不同、船长不同，却总是弯向同一片从不出现在官方星图上的安静空域。

#en: Cracked open in the quiet hum of the factory, the archive spills not words but coordinates and dates, a lattice of routes that circle the same cold scars in space.  \nCross-referenced with the first stray dataslate, the ghost echoes from that silent relay, and the falsified beacon logs from the old garrison, the pattern tightens, showing how every vanished ship has been steered toward one widening wound in the lanes where a patient engineer keeps rearranging the dead.
zh: 在工厂安静的嗡鸣中被撬开后，这份档案倾泻出的不是文字，而是坐标与日期，一座环绕太空中同样冰冷伤疤的航路格栅。\n与第一块散落数据板、来自那座沉默中继站的幽灵回声，以及旧驻军的伪造信标日志交叉比对，图案逐渐收紧，显示出每一艘消失的飞船都被引向航道上一道不断扩张的伤口——一名耐心的工程师在那里不断重新摆放逝者。

#en: Shattered telemetry from the drifting husk spills across the console, reforming into a rough lattice of traffic lanes and blind spots that should not exist, each gap stitched to a single maintenance ID tied back to this grease-stained garage on a forgotten rock.  \nFollowing that ghost pattern means leaving the comfort of official manifests and stepping into the same off-ledger shadows where an angry engineer learned to turn debris and drones into his own private toll road.
zh: 来自漂流残骸的碎裂遥测洒满控制台，重组为一座本不该存在的、由交通航道与盲点构成的粗略格栅，每一处空白都缝着同一个维护 ID，而它追溯回这块被遗忘岩石上这间沾满油污的车库。\n顺着这个幽灵图案追下去，就意味着离开官方舱单的舒适区，踏入同样的账外阴影——一名愤怒的工程师在那里学会了把残骸与无人机变成自己私人的收费公路。

#en: The wreck drifts apart in a slow halo of fragments, and beneath you a single set of coordinates blinks through the static, pulsing in time with archived dosing cycles aimed at one forgotten farmstead.  \nSomeone went to great trouble to hide that link behind scrambled traffic and half-truths. From the dark relay to the jittery clinic reports and the smuggler's doctored manifests, every trail of altered air and nervous denial has been bending toward this patch of dead fields.
zh: 残骸在一圈缓缓散开的碎片晕轮中解体，而在你下方，一组坐标在静电中闪烁，脉动的节拍与那些针对一座被遗忘农场的存档投药周期一致。\n有人费了很大功夫把这条关联藏在混乱的通讯与半真半假的说法之后。从黑暗的中继站，到神经质的诊所报告，再到走私贩被动过手脚的舱单，每一条被篡改空气与紧张否认的线索都一直弯向这片死去的田野。

#en: Buried among routine hauler routes and sanitized medical shipments, a thin thread of jumps repeats the same impossible angles, skirting known anomalies like someone tracing scars on the void.  \nCross checking those paths against earlier finds, the pattern tightens around one nameless stretch of space the same disturbance you first sniffed at a forgotten buoy, then heard whispered over drinks on that quiet farming rock, where nobody wanted to admit who recalibrated their sky.
zh: 埋在例行运货航线与经过净化处理的医疗货运之间，一缕纤细的跃迁线重复着同样的不可能角度，绕开已知异常，仿佛有人在虚空的伤疤上描画。\n把这些路径与此前的发现交叉核对，图案收紧到一片无名的空域——正是你最初在一座被遗忘浮标处嗅到、随后又在宁静农场岩石上喝酒时听人低语的同一处扰动，而那里没人愿意承认是谁重新校准了他们的天空。

#en: Decoded from the beacon's whisper, the Anchor Vector Ping doesn't name a place so much as outline a direction, a slant in grav-space all her routes lean toward.  \nCross-checking it with the backwater relay, the faulty orbital transmitter, and the misaligned traffic inside this vault ship, the pattern finally resolves: every manipulated jump has been quietly steering captains toward the same off-chart convergence, just beyond where official maps are willing to draw their lines.
zh: 从信标的低语中解码后，《锚点向量脉冲》与其说是点出某个地方，不如说是勾勒出一个方向——重力空间中所有航线都倾向的一个斜面。\n把它与穷乡中继站、故障的轨道发射机，以及这艘金库飞船内错位的交通交叉核对，图案终于解析：每一次被操纵的跃迁都在悄悄把船长们引向同一个图外汇聚点，就在官方地图愿意画下界线之处以外。

#en: Scorched plating on the drifting wreck tells a different story than the official incident code: impact signatures bend sideways, as if the ship tried to turn inside its own jump corridor and almost made it. Flight path reconstructions, half-wiped from beacon archives, show the same maneuver attempted again and again along nearby lanes, always from slightly different approach vectors, all nudging toward the same dark patch of space where traffic thins and grav readings never quite settle.
zh: 漂流残骸上被烧焦的装甲讲述着与官方事故代码不同的故事：撞击痕迹向侧面弯折，仿佛这艘船试图在自己的跃迁走廊内转向，而且几乎成功了。从信标档案中半被抹除的飞行路径重建显示，同样的机动在附近航道上被一遍遍地尝试，每次接近向量都略有不同，全都轻推向同一片黑暗空域——那里交通稀疏，重力读数始终无法稳定。

#en: In the silent racks of the abandoned post, the mixture's residue stains a single analysis bay, its readings spiking only when the receivers sweep past a narrow sliver of sky.  \nCross-referencing those fluctuations with the altered storm signatures from the frontier farm, the cut warning tapes from the forgotten relay, and the dead lab's failed experiments reveals the same thin corridor in space, a testing ground where gravity, weather, and traffic all begin to bend the way Vector wants.
zh: 在废弃哨站沉寂的架列中，混合物的残留污染了唯一一个分析舱，只有当接收器扫过天空中一条狭窄缝隙时，它的读数才会飙升。\n把那些波动与来自边境农场的被篡改风暴特征、来自被遗忘中继站被剪断的警告磁带，以及死实验室失败的实验交叉比对，便揭示出太空中同一条细薄走廊——一片试验场，那里的重力、天气与交通都开始按"向量"想要的方式弯折。

#en: When the pattern in the device finally resolves, half-forgotten coordinates from a dust-choked rock, corrupt traffic from a quiet lab, and misaligned pings from a lonely relay all snap into the same crooked flight path.  \nThat crooked line does not end here; it bends out into the dark toward a place where freighters go silent without ever filing distress, and where someone with a tug pilot's instincts has been waiting between scheduled lanes long enough to believe the system will never notice.
zh: 当装置中的图案终于清晰时，来自一块积满灰尘岩石的半被遗忘坐标、来自安静实验室的损坏交通，以及来自孤独中继站错位的脉冲，全都归入同一条弯曲的飞行路径。\n那条曲线并不止于此；它弯入黑暗，通向一个货船无声消失、从未发出求救的地方，也通向某个具备拖船飞行员直觉的人一直在计划航道之间守候、久到相信整个系统永远不会察觉之处。

#en: The readings carved into the wreck's guidance logs twist like a coiled line across the star map, linking old UC sensors, freighter routes, and a handful of marginal worlds that have all enjoyed impossible weather.  \nWhat looked like scattered interference now resolves into a single trajectory, bending every altered sky toward the same thin slice of space just beyond the official charts, tightening the hunt from dusty outposts and dead bounty ships to whatever waits along that hidden pressure path.
zh: 刻在残骸制导日志里的读数像一条盘绕的线横穿星图，把旧联殖传感器、货船航线，以及少数几颗都享受过不可能天气的边缘世界连在一起。\n看似零散的干扰如今解析成一条单一轨迹，把每一片被篡改的天空都弯向官方星图之外同一片狭薄空域，把追查从尘封的哨站和死去的赏金船收窄到那条隐秘压力路径上等待之物。

#en: The beacon's telemetry isn't just broadcasting position; buried in its soft-cycle pings is a repeating window where local sensors go blind, then a narrow grav-jump corridor aimed toward a dead patch of charted space.  \nCross-referenced with the anomalies at that abandoned homestead, the corrupted readings from the crippled satellite, and the substrate entries in the tower logs, the pattern finally resolves into a route she has been using over and over, always slipping just past official patrol lines.
zh: 信标的遥测不只广播位置；在它柔和的循环脉冲中埋着一扇反复出现的窗口——本地传感器会失明，随后是一条狭窄的重力跃迁走廊，指向已测绘太空中一片死寂区域。\n与那座废弃农场聚落的异常、来自受损卫星的损坏读数，以及塔内日志中的基质条目交叉比对，图案终于解析成一条她一再使用的路线，每次都恰好从官方巡逻线旁滑过。

#en: The relay techs say the rocks out there drift wrong, but their scopes keep logging the same faint pulse bending traffic around the field like water around a stone.  \nTied to the freight records you lifted in the moonside warehouse, that signal repeats the same skewed timing you saw in the crippled freighter's misjump and the doctored routes hidden in backwater manifests, all tracing the careful hand of one navigation analyst who has turned bad math into a weapon and is already setting his next corridor.
zh: 中继站的技术员说那边的岩石漂移得不对劲，但他们的示波器一直记录到同一道微弱脉冲，像水绕石头一样把交通弯过那片场区。\n与你从卫星侧仓库里取走的货运记录绑在一起，那道信号重复着你在受损货船错误跃迁中见过、也藏在穷乡舱单里的被动手脚航线的同样歪斜时序，全都勾勒出一名领航分析员小心翼翼的手——他把糟糕的数学变成了武器，而且已经在布置下一条走廊。

#en: The signal geometry etched into the soil should not match anything this far from a traffic hub, yet it dovetails perfectly with the irregular corridors traced in orbit.  \nComparing it against the earlier scraps from that backwater slate and the falsified cargo paths off the derelict depot, the pattern sharpens: a private chain of skewed jumps, abandoned wrecks, and delayed responses, all quietly curving toward the same stretch of darkened lanes where one unregistered tug is always a few minutes ahead of help.
zh: 刻入土壤的信号几何，本不该与离交通枢纽如此之远处的任何东西吻合，却与在轨道上追踪到的不规则走廊完美拼接。\n比照来自那块穷乡石板的更早碎片与从废弃仓库取下的伪造货运路径，图案变得锋利：一串私密的歪斜跃迁、被遗弃的残骸与迟缓的响应，全都悄然弯向同一片昏暗航道——那里总有一艘未登记的拖船，比救援早到几分钟。

#en: When the uplink's last cached transmission unspools, it carries not words but a chorus of distorted distress calls, all bent along the same narrow band of space and all cut short at nearly identical coordinates the official charts pretend are empty.  \nStacked beside the stray data from that forgotten rock and the mismatched pings recovered at the dead relay, the recording turns rumor into geometry, outlining a corridor of guided wrecks that curves toward an unnamed convergence far from any sanctioned traffic lane.
zh: 当上行链路最后缓存的传输展开时，它承载的不是文字，而是一组合唱般失真的求救呼叫，全都沿同一片狭窄空域弯折，全都在几乎相同、而官方星图假装空无一物的坐标处被戛然掐断。\n与来自那块被遗忘岩石的散落数据、以及从死中继站找回的对不上脉冲叠放在一起，这段录音把传言变成了几何，勾出一条由被引导残骸构成的走廊，弯向远离任何制式交通航道的一处无名汇聚点。

#en: A bartender wiping glasses with recycled greywater mentions taps that run clear one day, then metallic and thin the next, always after the same off-shift hauler crew rolls through.  \nAnother worker swears she saw unfamiliar techs checking valves in a closed-off corridor, while management insists nothing has changed; taken with the corrupted slate from the rock and the first whispers out of Neon, it sounds less like bad maintenance and more like someone quietly testing where they can bend a whole settlement's throat.
zh: 一名用回收灰水擦杯子的酒保提到，龙头一天流出清水，第二天就变得金属味十足、细弱无力，总是在同一批下班的运货船员经过之后。\n另一名工人发誓她看到陌生的技师在封闭走廊里检查阀门，而管理层坚称一切照旧；连同那块岩石上损坏的石板和从霓虹城传出的最早低语一起看，这听起来不像糟糕的维护，而更像有人在悄悄试探能把整座定居点的喉咙掰到什么程度。

#en: The entries scrawled across the manifest run like a spill themselves, scheduled routes warping into sudden diversions, whole shipments vanishing into the margins where no port name is printed.  \nCross-checking the times and cargo with that stray slate from the backworld rock and the half-spoken accounts from freight hands, a pattern emerges: routine hauls quietly peeled off the main lanes, always after the same delayed response, always toward the same stretch of space where records thin out and wreck reports pile up.
zh: 横贯舱单的那些潦草条目本身就像一次泼洒，排定的航线扭曲成突如其来的改道，整批货物消失在没印任何港口名的页边。\n把时间与货物同来自穷乡岩石的那块散落石板、货运工人们半吞半吐的讲述交叉核对，一个图案浮现：例行货载悄然从主航道剥离，总在同样的迟缓响应之后，总朝着同一片记录变稀、残骸报告堆叠的空域。

#en: The fragment hidden in orbit is like a mirror cracked on purpose; its equations fork in two clear directions, one pointing back toward polished corridors and oversight logs, the other out toward the loose edge of the lanes where no one files proper reports.  \nDecoded, it tells you that every falsified accident in the lab and every whispered correction from frontier captains were not random strokes of genius or madness, but parts of a single model being tested both in the heart of UC territory and far beyond its reach.
zh: 藏在轨道中的这块碎片像一面被故意打碎的镜子；它的方程朝两个清晰的方向分叉，一支指回光鲜的走廊与监管日志，另一支指向航道松散边缘——那里无人提交正式报告。\n解码后，它告诉你实验室里每一起伪造事故、边境船长们每一句低语的修正，都不是天才或疯狂的随机笔触，而是同一个模型的一部分，既在联殖领地的心脏、也在其触不可及之处被测试着。

#en: The trace pattern clinging to that lonely rock matches a faint chemical and grav signature now detected on a forgotten satellite in distant orbit, as if the same hand tested its tricks in both places.  \nTaken with the corrupted log at the first outpost and the off-kilter readings from the earlier transmitter, this residue finally links ground, sky, and drift into one continuous line, suggesting she has been walking her experiments outward step by careful step, always along corridors everyone assumed they already understood.
zh: 附着在那块孤独岩石上的痕迹图案，与如今在一颗遥远轨道中被遗忘卫星上探测到的微弱化学与重力特征吻合，仿佛同一只手在这两处试验过自己的把戏。\n连同第一座哨站里损坏的日志与更早那台发射机失常的读数一起看，这些残留终于把地面、天空与漂流连成一条连续的线，暗示她一直在小心地一步步把实验向外推进，总是沿着所有人都以为早已理解的走廊。

#en: When the canisters rupture and the last shimmer of altered space bleeds off into the dust, the Razor Strays' bravado goes with it; what they were guarding was never just hardware, but the promise of more "miracle shortcuts" to sell.  \n\nIn the wreckage their handler's slate keeps blinking, still queued to transmit calibration logs and payment records to a single repeating contact tag, the same one buried in a doctored manifest on that drifting cargo hauler and echoed in the corrupted slate from the rock where this all began.
zh: 当储罐爆裂、被篡改空间的最后一丝微光渗入尘土时，剃刀流浪帮的气焰也随之消散；他们守护的从来不只是硬件，而是兜售更多"奇迹捷径"的承诺。\n\n在残骸中，他们那位经手人的石板仍在不停闪烁，仍排队要把校准日志与付款记录发送到一个反复出现的单一联系标签——它同样埋在那艘漂流货船被动过手脚的舱单里，也回响于这场追查起始之岩石上那块损坏的石板中。

#en: When you sync the fractured signal from the node with the hangar's stripped down systems, two streams of data resolve into one map overlay, tracing outbound environmental commands from the derelict bay to a single, unlisted coordinate in deep space.  \nThe pattern matches testimonies from frightened settlers planetside and the buried UC logs you pried out of that listening post, confirming that every "upgrade" and every falsified incident has been feeding the same hidden endpoint, waiting for someone to notice the convergence.
zh: 当你把来自节点的断裂信号与机库被拆空后的系统同步时，两股数据流解析成一张地图叠加层，从废弃的船坞舱一路勾出向外的环境指令，直到深空中一个未登记的单一坐标。\n这图案与地表惊恐定居者的证词、以及你从那座监听站撬出的被掩埋联殖日志吻合，证实每一次"升级"和每一起伪造事件都在喂养同一个隐秘终点，只等着有人注意到这处汇聚。

#en: The pattern encoded in the drift around this point is not a destination, but a decision; the lane math splits in two clean branches, each ending at a different cluster of anomalies Vector has been quietly feeding with his tests.  \nDecoding it turns every half-whispered story from technicians and captains into coordinates instead of campfire talk, leaving you with a stark choice between chasing the bureaucrats who buried the first reports or the settlers and haulers who have been living with his experiments at the edge of mapped space.
zh: 编码在这处漂移中的图案不是一个目的地，而是一个决定；航道数学分岔成两支干净的枝干，各自终止于"向量"一直用测试悄然喂养的不同异常簇。\n解码它，便把技术员和船长们每一段半带低语的故事从篝火闲谈变成坐标，摆在你面前的是一个赤裸的选择：去追那些掩埋了最初报告的官僚，还是去追那些一直与他在制图空间边缘的实验共处的定居者和运货船员。

#en: The mech's drifting telemetry burns away in a brief, silent flare, and with it goes the last excuse that these scattered anomalies were just leftover war junk.  \nStripped of that relay, the remaining data points line up in an uncomfortable way: a quietly corrected foreclosure on a nowhere farm, a scratched dataslate buried in dust, a survey node whispering the same offset coordinates, all suggesting that someone patient has been testing how far they can bend both battles and balance sheets without anyone realizing the pattern is theirs.
zh: 机甲的漂流遥测在一道短暂无声的闪光中烧尽，随之而去的还有最后一个借口——这些零散异常只是战争遗留的废料。\n剥去那座中继站后，剩余的数据点在一种令人不适的方式下对齐：一座无名农场上被悄然修正的止赎、一块埋在尘土里被划花的数据板、一个低声重复着同样偏移坐标的勘测节点，全都暗示有一个耐心的人一直在试探能否把战斗与资产负债表都掰弯，而没人意识到这图案出自他手。

#en: Buried in the outpost's dim core, the archive lays out early simulations like a confession whispered to the void, mapping which stations bend first, which routes fracture cleanly, which colonies can be pushed to the edge without quite falling.  \nMatched against the first stray log from that lonely surface site and the unnaturally complete cache drifting in dead orbit, these seed calculations turn scattered accidents into a rough blueprint, hinting that someone has been rehearsing collapse on a scale far larger than any single ring or ship.
zh: 埋在哨站昏暗的核心中，这份档案铺陈出早期模拟，像对着虚空低声吐露的忏悔，标出哪些空间站会最先弯折、哪些航线会干净地断裂、哪些殖民地能被推到边缘而不至于坠落。\n与来自那座孤独地表站点的第一份散落日志、以及死寂轨道中漂流的、异常完整的藏匿点比对，这些初始计算把零散的事故变成一份粗略蓝图，暗示有人一直在演练崩溃，其规模远超任何单一圆环或飞船。

#en: Test runs in the tower show the same chemical signature appearing on opposite sides of the system within minutes, tagged to shipments that never physically moved.  \nBuried in those reports is a repeated route reference that matches the doctored foreclosure reversal on the Freestar world, the misaligned traffic records near the orbital beacon, and the self-contradicting manifests from the abandoned SysDef hull, all pointing toward one corridor where someone has been quietly rehearsing how to move lives on paper faster than any ship can fly.
zh: 塔内的测试运行显示，同样的化学特征在几分钟内出现在星系两端，却标注在从未实际移动过的货物上。\n埋在这些报告里的是一处反复出现的航路引用，它与自由星系联盟世界被动手脚的止赎撤销、轨道信标附近错位的交通记录，以及从被弃联殖防务船体上取下、自相矛盾的舱单吻合，全都指向同一条走廊——有人一直在那里悄悄演练如何让生命在纸面上移动得比任何飞船都快。

#en: Someone etched the same two words you pulled from crowded terminals and whispered bar talk into the side of a rusting grain silo, then repeated them in the approach telemetry burned across the landing pad.  \nGrey Orchard Vector is not a phrase settlers would invent; it is a heading, a name, and a destination folded into one.  \nSeeing it here, on a farm that should have been anonymous, ties together the dead dataslate in the black, the scrambled orbital records, and every survivor who swore their careful pilot knew this place would never last.
zh: 有人把你从拥挤终端与低声酒吧闲谈中挖出的那两个词刻在一座生锈谷仓的侧面，随后又在横贯着陆平台的接近遥测中重复了它们。\n"灰果园向量"不是定居者会编造出的说法；它是一个航向、一个名字与一个目的地折叠成的整体。\n在一座本应无名的农场上看到它，把黑暗中那块死数据板、混乱的轨道记录，以及每一个发誓他们那位谨慎的飞行员早知道这地方撑不了多久的幸存者，串在了一起。

#en: The timing matrix tucked in that research module looks harmless at first glance, just another logistics draft abandoned when funding dried up, but every recurrence date lines up with unexplained supply spikes and missing manifests from other files.  \nFollowed back through the half scrubbed records and the trail matches what I heard in the queues and from that nervous caseworker in New Atlantis a pattern of quiet approvals, diverted shipments, and erased coordinates, all suggesting someone has been feeding an unseen settlement on a fixed, patient rhythm.
zh: 塞在那台研究模块里的时序矩阵乍看无害，不过是又一份因资金枯竭而被弃置的物流草案，但它每一个重现日期都与无法解释的补给尖峰、以及来自其他文件的缺失舱单对齐。\n穿过那些半被擦净的记录回溯，这条线索与我在队列中、从新亚特兰蒂斯城那位紧张个案员口中听到的东西吻合——一幅安静的审批、改道的货运与被抹除坐标构成的图案，全都暗示有人一直以固定、耐心的节奏喂养一座看不见的定居点。

#en: When the chart finishes compiling inside the factory's core, the lines it draws are not trade routes but scars, looping again and again through the same dead corridors and anchoring on a point the nav software insists does not exist.  \nStacked beside the stray dataslate from that forgotten rock, the corrupted ping logs from the silent relay, and the doctored beacon records taken from the abandoned garrison, the pattern stops looking like coincidence and starts reading like a deliberate hand guiding traffic toward a single, carefully hidden gathering of wrecks.
zh: 当星图在工厂核心内部编译完成时，它画出的线条不是贸易航线，而是伤疤，一遍遍地绕着同样的死走廊循环，锚定在导航软件坚称不存在的一个点上。\n与来自那块被遗忘岩石的散落数据板、来自沉默中继站的损坏脉冲日志，以及从被弃驻军取走的伪造信标记录叠放在一起，这图案不再像巧合，而开始读起来像一只刻意的手，把交通引向一处被精心藏匿的残骸聚集地。
